blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code. Autoformalization from natural-language problems is promising, yet training specification models requires scalable feedback on whether generated specifications capture intended behavior. Prior approaches obtain this feedback through explicit proofs or separately implemented code with formal correspondence proofs, both expensive. We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework that pairs declarative postconditions with executable counterparts, obtained through type class resolution when possible and otherwise defined separately with an equivalence proof. Test cases can then evaluate declarative specifications by execution, letting us use agreement as a reinforcement-learning reward. Using AuXSpec, we synthesize 3,037 LeetCode problems and expand training to 19.5K samples through expert iteration on Codeforces. Experiments show that training Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with the execution-based reward improves SpecGen pass@4 on AuXSpec-Test 0.7% $\to$ 82.7% and 14.3% $\to$ 84.3%, and the 27B model outperforms all frontier models. On the out-of-domain Verina benchmark with its original prompts, both models improve 7.0% $\to$ 90.5% and 21.9% $\to$ 90.5% and surpass VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, the prior state of the art among open-source specification models, on pass@1 (theirs 47.6% vs. ours 73.7% and 84.5%) and pass@4 (theirs 63.9% at pass@10 vs. ours 90.5%). We release the weights of the trained 9B and 27B models and the 3,037 problems with test cases, including the 300-problem AuXSpec-Test benchmark with expert review and correctness proofs for future evaluation. Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. Website: https://auxspec.org
blocks.zh: 正式的规格定义了预期的程序行为并支撑了验证,但在Lean等定理证明器中书写它们很慢,而且需要大量的专门知识,使得规格成为了正式正确代码缩放的主要瓶颈. 来自自然语言问题的自动形式化是很有希望的,然而培训规格模型需要可扩展的反馈,以了解生成的规格是否能够捕捉预期的行为. 以前的做法通过明确的证明或带有正式公文证明的单独执行的代码获得这种反馈,两者都是昂贵的. 我们引入了AuXSpec, 一种精益框架, 将声明性后置条件与可执行的后置条件对齐, 尽可能通过类解析度获得, 然后,测试案例可以通过执行来评估申报的规格,让我们利用协议作为补充学习的奖励。 使用AuXSpec,我们合成了3,037个LetCode问题,并通过关于Codeforce的专家迭代将培训扩大到19.5K个样本. 实验显示,使用执行奖励的Quen3.5-9B和Quen3.8-27B培训改进了SpecGen在AuxSpec-Test上的通过@4 0.7%到82.7%,14.3%到84.3%,27B模型的效绩超过了所有前沿模型. 根据Verina域外基准及其原始提示,两种模型都提高了7.0%至90.5%和21.9%至90.5%,并超过了VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, 开源规格模型的先行技术水平为:通行@1(47.6%对我国73.7%和84.5%)和通过@4(在通行@10对我国90.5%)。 我们公布训练有素的9B和27B型号的权重和3,037个测试案例的问题,包括300个问题AuXSpec测试基准,并附有专家审查和正确性证明,供今后评估。 模型和数据:https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. 网址:https://auxspec.org

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Formal program specifications define the correct behavior of a program over all valid inputs, providing the reference against which implementations can be proved correct or tested. Yet writing such specifications in an interactive theorem prover requires substantial expertise and effort, making specification a fundamental barrier to scaling formal code verification and generation. As AI models make rapid progress in generating code and proving its correctness, this barrier becomes increasingly important: realizing the promise of formally correct code requires automating specification itself. Autoformalization from natural-language programming problems offers a path forward, but immediately raises a central question: when does a generated formal specification faithfully capture the intended problem?
blocks.zh: 正式的程序规格定义一个程序在所有有效输入上的正确行为,提供可以证明执行正确或测试的参考. 然而,用交互式定理证明书写这种规格需要大量的专门知识和精力,使规格成为扩大正式编码核查和生成的基本障碍。 随着AI模型在生成代码并证明它的正确性方面取得快速进展,这个障碍变得越来越重要:实现正式正确代码的承诺需要自动化规格本身. 来自自然语言编程问题的自动形式化提供了一个前进的道路,但立即提出了一个中心问题:生成的正式规格何时能忠实地抓住预期的问题?

blocks.en:
This question is particularly important in modern code-generation pipelines.
Large language models (LLMs) can generate solutions to programming problems (e.g., LeetCode) from natural-language descriptions. These solutions can be evaluated using input-output test cases, which provide scalable reward signals for reinforcement learning ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Ruan et al., 2026 ) .
However, passing test cases does not guarantee correctness, as a solution may still fail on untested inputs ( Shi et al., 2026 ) .
Formal verification offers a stronger guarantee.
Given a specification, which consists of a precondition defining valid inputs and a postcondition characterizing correct outputs ( Endres et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , a theorem prover like Lean can formally prove that an implementation satisfies its specification for every valid input.
This guarantee depends on the specification correctly capturing the natural-language problem, yet producing such specifications at scale remains difficult.
Manually curating specifications requires substantial expert effort: Clever and Verina contain only 161 and 189 problems, respectively ( Thakur et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026a ) . Automated methods can scale further, but may produce incorrect specifications ( Dougherty & Mehta, 2025 ; Bursuc et al., 2026 ; Dougherty et al., 2026 ) . Scaling specification therefore requires more than generating formal statements. It also requires efficient and scalable feedback on whether generated specifications match the source problem, analogous to the test-case feedback used to train code-generation models.
blocks.zh:
这个问题在现代代码生成管道中特别重要.
大语言模型(LLMs)可以从自然语言描述中生成编程问题的解决方案(如:LetCode). 这些解决方案可以使用输入输出测试案例进行评估,这些案例为强化学习提供了可扩展的奖励信号(Wang等,2025;Ruan等,2026.).
然而,通过测试的案例并不能保证正确性,因为一个解决方案在未经测试的投入上仍然可能失败(Shi等,2026.).
正式核查提供了更强有力的保证。
根据一个规定,包括确定有效投入的先决条件和确定正确产出的附加条件(Endres等,2024;Chen等,2026),像Lean这样的定理证明人可以正式证明,每项有效投入的执行符合其规定。
这种保证取决于正确反映自然语言问题的规格,但这种规格的规模仍然很困难。
人工管理规格需要大量专家努力:Clever和Verina分别只包含161和189个问题(Thakur等,2025;Ye等,2026a.)。 自动化方法可以进一步扩展,但可能产生不正确的规格(Dougherty & Mehta,2025;Bursuc等,2026;Dougherty等,2026.). 因此,扩大规格要求的不仅仅是产生正式声明。 它还要求对生成的规格是否与源问题相匹配的高效而可扩展的反馈,类似于用于训练代码生成模型的测试案例反馈.

blocks.en:
Training specification generators has been explored in auto-active verification languages, where a verifier, like an SMT solver, provides the reward by checking candidate specifications on test cases ( Yan et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Baksys et al., 2025 ) .
However, SMT solvers limit the complexity of specifications that can be checked ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026a ) , motivating the use of interactive theorem provers such as Lean.
In Lean, prior work checks generated specifications by turning each test case into a theorem to be proved, a method known as symbolic specification testing ( Lahiri, 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . These theorems can require nontrivial proofs, especially when the specification involves unbounded quantifiers.
If a proof cannot be found, the test case may be left unresolved or evaluated by an LLM judge. Thus, unlike in code generation ( Wang et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2026 ) , test cases do not directly provide cheap rewards for training specification generators in Lean (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
已用自动活性核查语言探索了培训规格生成器,其中核查员与SMT解析员一样,通过检查测试案例的候选规格提供奖励(Yan等,2026;Huang等,2026;Baksys等,2025)。
然而,SMT解析器限制了可被检查的规格的复杂性(Yang等,2026;Ye等,2026a),激发了Lean等交互定理证明器的使用.
在Lean中,前期工作检查通过将每个测试案例变成有待证明的定理,生成了规格,这种方法被称为符号规格测试(Lahiri, 2024;Ye等, 2026b; Yang等, 2026.). 这些定理可以要求非三角证明,特别是在规格涉及无约束的限定词时.
如果找不到证据,试验案件可能得不到解决或由LLM法官进行评估。 因此,与代码生成不同(Wang等人,2025年;He等人,2026年),测试案例并不直接为Lean培训规格发电机提供廉价奖励(表1).

blocks.en:
To address this issue, we propose AuXSpec , a framework for training models to generate program specifications in Lean 4. AuXSpec retains a declarative postcondition that specifies correctness independently of the implementation and pairs it with an executable postcondition for evaluating test cases, a pairing with a long history in formal methods (Section 6 ).
For each synthesized problem, we prove a postcondition equivalence theorem, separately from generation (Section 2 ), showing that the two postconditions agree for every valid input. This theorem allows us to evaluate any number of test cases by direct execution in Lean, without proving each case separately.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用AuXSpec,这是在Lean 4中生成程序规格的培训模式框架。 AuXSpec保留了一个声明后条件,该条件与执行独立地具体规定正确性,并配以可执行后条件来评价测试案例,这种条件与正式方法中的长期历史相配(第6节)。
对于每一个被合成的问题,我们证明一个条件后等同定理,与生成分开(第2节),表明两个条件后同意每一个有效的输入. 这个定理允许我们在利恩通过直接行刑来评估任何数量的测试案件,而不单独证明每个案件.

blocks.en:
We build a synthesis pipeline to generate Lean specifications and implementations for 3,037 LeetCode problems.
For model training, we combine synthesized data from LeetCode and Codeforces with expert iteration to obtain 19.5K samples for supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
blocks.zh:
我们建造了合成管道 以生成精度规格 和实施 3,037 LeetCode问题。
对于模型培训,我们把LetCode和CodeForce的合成数据与专家迭代数据结合起来,以获得19.5K个样本,用于监督微调(SFT).

blocks.en:
We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B on these samples and then apply reinforcement learning (RL) with our execution-based reward on 13,637 tasks over 8,579 further problems. The resulting AuXSpec -9B and AuXSpec -27B models can generate and repair both specifications and implementations.
Relative to its base model, AuXSpec -27B improves SpecGen pass@4 from 14.3% to 84.3% on AuXSpec -Test and from 21.9% to 90.5% on Verina with its original prompts. The corresponding improvements for AuXSpec -9B are from 0.7% to 82.7% and from 7.0% to 90.5%. Moreover, RL with our execution-based reward improves SpecGen pass@4 over SFT alone for both model sizes (Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们微调了Quen3.5-9B和Quen3.8-27 B在这些样本上,然后应用强化学习(RL),通过执行奖励,奖励13 637项任务,超过8 579个其他问题。 由此产生的AuXSpec-9B和AuXSpec-27B模型可以生成并修复规格和实施.
相对于其基准型号,AuXSpec-27B在AuXSpec - Test上改进了SpecGen pass@4,从14.3%到84.3%,在Verina上则从21.9%到90.5%,加上原来的提示. AuXSpec -9B的相应改进从0.7%到82.7%,从7.0%到90.5%. 此外,通过执行奖励,RL改进了SpecGen仅通过SFT的两种型号(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. • Executable specification format. We introduce a specification format that pairs a declarative postcondition with an executable Boolean postcondition, obtained through type class resolution in Lean when a decidability instance exists and defined separately otherwise. A postcondition equivalence theorem proves that the two agree on valid inputs (Section 2 ). • AuXSpec dataset and AuXSpec -Test. We release the 3,037 LeetCode problems with specifications, implementations, frozen test cases and postcondition equivalence proofs, including AuXSpec -Test, an expert-reviewed subset of 300 problems that serves as a benchmark for Lean specification generation (Sections 3 and 3.3 ). • AuXSpec -9B-RL and AuXSpec -27B-RL. Using our execution-based reward, we train and release open-weight models that generate and repair Lean specifications and implementations from natural-language descriptions. AuXSpec -27B-RL surpasses all frontier models in domain, and both models surpass the prior state of the art among open-source specification models on Verina (Tables 4 and 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 • 可执行规格格式。 我们采用了一种规格格式,将声明后条件与可执行的布尔后条件相配,当存在可解析性实例时,通过Lean的类别分辨率获得,并另行定义。 附加条件等同定理证明,两者同意有效投入(第2节)。 • AuXSpec数据集和AuXSpec - Test. 我们公布了3 037个与规格、实施、被冻结的试验案例和条件后等同的证明有关的LetCode问题,其中包括AuXSpec - Test,这是由专家审查的300个问题,作为Lean规格生成的基准(第3和3.3节)。 • AuxSpec -9B-RL和AuxSpec -27B-RL. 利用我们基于执行的奖励,我们从自然语言描述中培养并释放出能生成并修复Lean规格和执行的开量模型. AuXSpec -27B-RL超越了域内所有前沿模型,两个模型都超越了Verina上的开源规格模型(表4和表5)中之前的先进水平.

blocks.en: 2 Problem formulation
blocks.zh: 2 问题表述

blocks.en:
In our autoformalization setup, we represent each programming problem with a Lean file.
This section describes the file format, the generation and repair tasks over its components, and the acceptance criteria used in data synthesis, model training and evaluation.
blocks.zh:
在我们的自动正规化设置中,我们用一个精益文件代表每个编程问题.
本节介绍文件格式,其组件的生成和修复任务,以及数据合成,模型培训和评价中使用的接受标准.

blocks.en:
Format. For each programming problem, we take a natural-language problem description, input constraints, and test cases as input, and aim to produce a Lean file containing a specification, an implementation, two theorem statements, and executable tests (Figures 13 and 15a in Appendix G.2.1 ).
The specification consists of a precondition defining valid inputs, a declarative postcondition characterizing correct outputs independently of how they are computed, and an executable postcondition that expresses the same condition in a form that can be directly evaluated on test cases by Lean.
The implementation is an algorithm that computes an output from a given input.
The file also contains two theorems: the postcondition equivalence theorem , asserting that the two postconditions agree on valid inputs, and the correctness theorem , asserting that the implementation satisfies the declarative postcondition.
We include the test cases in the Lean file as #guard commands that check the precondition, the executable postcondition and the implementation.
We illustrate the format with two synthesized problems, Count Number of Special Subsequences and Continuous Subarray Sum (Appendix G.2.1 ).
blocks.zh:
形式。 对于每个编程问题,我们以自然语言问题描述,输入限制,测试案例作为输入,并旨在生成一个Lean文件,包含一个规格,一个执行,两个定理说明,以及可执行测试(附录G.2.1中的图13和15a.
规格包括界定有效输入的先决条件、独立于计算正确产出的特性的申报后条件,以及以Lean可直接对试验案例评价的形式表达相同条件的可执行后条件。
执行是一个算法,通过给定输入计算输出.
文件还包含两个定理: 后条件等同定理 主张两个后条件就有效输入达成一致 正确性定理 主张执行满足声明后条件.
我们在Lean文件中将测试例作为#guard命令来检查先决条件,可执行后的条件和执行.
我们用两个综合问题来说明格式,即特殊子序列的数和连续子序列和(附录G.2.1.)。

blocks.en: Tasks. We train our models on specification generation (SpecGen) and code generation (CodeGen), as in prior work ( Ye et al., 2026a ) , and their repair variants, SpecGen-Repair and CodeGen-Repair (Table 2 ). The synthesis pipeline performs these tasks and assembles the generated components into complete Lean files to build the training data and test set.
blocks.zh: 任务 我们用规格生成(SpecGen)和代码生成(CodeGen)来培训我们的模型,就像以前的工作(Ye等人,2026a),以及他们的修理变体SpecGen-Repair和代码生成(表2). 合成管道执行这些任务,将生成的组件组装成完整的Lean文件来构建训练数据和测试集.

blocks.en: Table 2: Input and output of each task. Broken is the rejected output that a repair task revises, and Diagnostics are the compiler errors and failed test cases of that output. Test layers check the output (Table 7 in Appendix A.2 ).
blocks.zh: 表2:每项任务的投入和产出。 断是修补任务修改的被否决的输出,而诊断是该输出的编译器错误和失败的测试案例. 试验层检查产出(附录A.2表7)。

blocks.en: Acceptance criteria. We apply a common set of acceptance criteria for data filtering, expert iteration, reinforcement learning and evaluation. A generated output is accepted only if the assembled file compiles, the task-specific test layers pass, and LLM judges approve ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 接受标准。 我们采用一套共同的接受标准进行数据过滤、专家迭代、强化学习和评价。 生成的输出只有在组装文件编译,任务特定测试层通过,LLM评委批准的情况下才被接受(郑等,2023).

blocks.en:
Test cases are fixed before synthesis and executed as #guard commands, which fail at compilation when the expression is false.
The commands are organized into layers by component and type of test (Table 7 in Appendix A.2 ), and the generated commands must match the frozen test cases.
Beyond the test cases, LLM judges check faithfulness (whether the postcondition captures the problem’s requirements), non-tautology (whether the postcondition characterizes correct outputs rather than restating a solution algorithm), completeness (whether the executable postcondition accepts correct outputs on untested inputs) and termination (whether the implementation terminates on valid inputs).
blocks.zh:
测试例在合成前被固定,并被执行为#guard命令,当表达式是虚假的时,在编译时失败.
指令按组件和测试类型分层排列(附录A.2表7),生成的命令必须与被冻结的测试案例相匹配.
除了测试案例之外,LLM法官还检查可靠性(是否附加条件包含问题的要求)、非图解性(是否附加条件是正确产出的特征,而不是重述一个解决方案算法)、完整性(是否可执行的附加条件接受未经测试投入的正确产出)和终止性(执行是否终止于有效投入)。

blocks.en:
Proofs. The Lean file includes two theorem statements, whose proofs are left as sorry throughout data synthesis, training, and evaluation.
We instead adopt executable tests and LLM judges as acceptance criteria, and assess the reliability of these checks separately.
For 35.5% of the synthesized problems, the executable postcondition is obtained directly through decidability instances and agrees with the declarative postcondition by construction. After synthesis, we attempt to prove postcondition equivalence for all 3,037 problems, and 99.0% are provable without modifying their definitions (Section 3.2 ), which indicates that the proofs expose errors beyond tests and judges in only 1.0% of the synthesized problems. The remaining problems are repaired and then proved.
For model-generated specifications, we also validate acceptance by proof, and the postcondition equivalence theorem holds for 99.2% of accepted outputs of both RL models (Appendix H.4 ). We note that the proved theorem shows only that the two postconditions agree, but both may encode the same misunderstanding: expert review finds 9 such errors among the 300 AuXSpec -Test problems (Appendix I.1 ). Semantic agreement with the problem therefore rests on the test cases, the judges and expert review (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 3.1 Synthesis pipeline

blocks.en:
Our pipeline takes a problem description and test cases as input
(Figure 1 ).
We first make a problem-level plan, then generate the declarative
specification (the precondition and the declarative postcondition), the executable postcondition, and the implementation in
three stages.
In each stage, we plan and generate a component, validate it against the acceptance criteria of Section 2 and repair it if validation fails. We separate the stages to prevent the generation of a later component from overfitting the test cases or weakening an accepted specification ( Baksys et al., 2025 ) . Finally, we assemble the accepted components into a Lean file
in the format of Section 2 .

Specification. We first generate the precondition and the declarative
postcondition. To make the declarative postcondition executable, we apply decide when a decidability instance is available and otherwise attempt to synthesize such an instance (Appendix G.2 ). The result, called the decidable form, agrees with the declarative postcondition by construction. When instance synthesis fails, the declarative postcondition is reformulated into a separate executable postcondition, and the postcondition equivalence theorem, proved after synthesis (Section 3.2 ), states that the executable postcondition agrees with the declarative postcondition.

blocks.en: Models. Based on a pilot comparison of frontier models (Appendix G.8 ), we select Kimi-K3 ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) for generation and repair, DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) for planning, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash for the judges.

blocks.en: 3.2 Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果

blocks.en:
The pipeline synthesizes 3,037 of the 3,109 problems (97.7%, Appendix G.5 ).
Only 34.8% of the problems pass all stages at the first attempt, and repair recovers most of the others within 2 rounds (Appendix G.4.1 ).
For 35.5% of the synthesized problems, the declarative postcondition can be made executable by decide .
These executable postconditions pass validation on the first attempt in 98.1% of cases, compared with 52.4% for those generated separately (Appendix G.2.2 ).
Since tests on small inputs do not detect nontermination or inefficiency, the implementation judge rejects 19.6% of the generated implementations that pass all test cases (Appendix G.3.1 ).

只有34.8%的问题在第一次尝试时通过所有阶段,而修复则在2发内恢复了大部分其他阶段(附录G.4.1)。

这些可执行条件在98.1%的案例中通过第一次尝试验证,而单独生成的则通过52.4%(附录G.2.2.)。

After synthesis, we attempt to prove the postcondition equivalence theorem for all 3,037 problems (Appendix H ), and the attempts expose statement errors in 31 problems (1.0%), all of which had passed the test layers and the judges.
Most of these errors (19) are in the declarative postcondition, which execution never evaluates (Table 39 in Appendix H ).
We repair the 31 problems and then prove the theorem.
For the remaining 99.0% of the problems, the theorem is provable as synthesized.

blocks.en: 3.3 AuXSpec -Test

blocks.en:
AuXSpec -Test is a held-out evaluation benchmark consisting of 300 problems from the synthesized dataset, with 72 easy, 155 medium and 73 hard problems, yielding 834 samples across four tasks (Table 11 in Appendix C.3 ).
We manually review every component against the problem description and identify errors in 21 problems (Appendix I.1 ).
Attempts to prove the correctness theorems reveal one additional error (Appendix H.3 ).
We correct these 22 problems and prove correctness for all 300; the remaining 278 problems (92.7%) require no changes to their definitions.

Since evaluation relies on test cases and judges rather than comparison with the reference specification, it can accept alternative correct formulations.

blocks.en: Each synthesized problem contributes samples to the tasks of Section 2 . The generation tasks take accepted components as targets, and the repair tasks take components rejected during synthesis as inputs. To obtain a starting point for RL that reasons concisely, we rephrase the long and often redundant reasoning recorded during synthesis into a short trace of the planning behind a generated component or the diagnosis behind a repair (Appendix G.6 ).

Increasing the number of problems improves SpecGen performance more than continued pretraining on a Mathlib corpus (Appendix E.2 ).
We therefore source further problems for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) from Codeforces, AtCoder, Aizu, CodeChef and GeeksforGeeks through TACO ( Li et al., 2023 ) and open-r1/codeforces ( Penedo et al., 2025 ) (Table 3 ). To eliminate the risk of data contamination, the final SFT and RL data are disjoint from each other and from the evaluation benchmarks (Appendix C ).

SpecGen performance rises as the data grow, with no sign of saturation (Appendix E.1 ). blocks.en:
Reward design. Since the SFT models solve only 10.1% and 18.7% of SpecGen problems at pass@1 (Section 5.2 ), a binary reward that requires all acceptance criteria induces low reward variance, which slows optimization even when the reward is faithful to the acceptance criteria ( Razin et al., 2025 ) . We therefore score each rollout with a 6-stage progressive reward that follows the order of the acceptance criteria of Section 2 ( Le et al., 2022 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Failing a stage assigns the rollout the value of that stage, from format (0), compilation (0.1), test execution (0.2), test case alignment (0.1), non-tautology (0.1) to overall quality (0.4), and passing all stages yields 1. With v k v_{k} the value of stage k k , the reward of rollout y y is r ⁡ ( y ) = { 1 if ​ y ​ passes all stages, v k if ​ k ​ is the first stage that ​ y ​ fails. r(y)=\begin{cases}1&\text{if }y\text{ passes all stages,}\\
v_{k}&\text{if }k\text{ is the first stage that }y\text{ fails.}\end{cases} (1) We value non-tautology at 0.1 to rank specifications that restate the computation without specifying the problem below failed tests. Replaying the training rollouts shows that at this value tautological specifications have a negative mean advantage in every group, whereas at a higher value such as 0.3 the advantage turns positive in groups where no rollout passes (Appendix E.3.2 ). Two kinds of rollouts that pass all stages receive partial credit instead of 1, enumerative specifications (0.4) and slow implementations (0.5), which evaluation accepts. To prevent reward hacking, a test counts toward the required number of tests only if it calls a declaration of the output, which excludes tests that hold trivially. Falling short of this number reduces the reward to 0.1. Hard-coding answers, by special-casing the test inputs or by copying the given test cases into the implementation, sets the reward to 0, and so does returning a repair unchanged (Appendix E.3.1 ).

blocks.en:
Self-repair. Besides generation, we train on repair tasks built from failed rollouts of the current policy, which avoids distribution shift ( Kumar et al., 2025 ) .
During training, these failed rollouts are paired with compiler messages or judge feedback in a buffer, from which 40% of each batch is drawn as single-turn repair tasks (Table 2 ). Repairs continue for up to 3 rounds, and the reward of a repair rollout is scaled down linearly from 1 in the first round to 0.8 in the last.
blocks.zh:
自我修养. 除了一代人之外,我们还对因现行政策失败而建造的修理任务进行培训,以避免分配转移(Kumar等,2025年)。
在培训期间,这些失败的推出与编译器信息配对,或以缓冲器判断反馈,从中抽取出每批40%作为单回合修复任务(表2). 修理持续了多达3发,修理推广的奖励从第一轮的1发直线缩减到最后一轮的0.8发.

blocks.en: Policy optimization. Our RL algorithm extends Decoupled Clip and Dynamic Sampling Policy Optimization ( Yu et al., 2025 , DAPO;) by normalizing the advantage by the standard deviation over the batch instead of the group ( Hu et al., 2025 ) and masking the clipped surrogate ℓ i , t \ell_{i,t} of token t t in rollout i i with m i , t ∈ { 0 , 1 } m_{i,t}\in\{0,1\} . We maximize 𝒥 ⁡ ( θ ) = 𝔼 ⁡ [ ∑ i , t m i , t ​ ℓ i , t ​ ( θ ) ∑ i , t m i , t ] , \mathcal{J}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}\Big[\frac{\sum_{i,t}m_{i,t}\,\ell_{i,t}(\theta)}{\sum_{i,t}m_{i,t}}\Big], (2) which reduces to the original algorithm with m i , t = 1 m_{i,t}=1 and group normalization. We classify a rollout as repetitive if a 40-character n-gram occurs at least 20 times and over 40% of n-grams are repeats ( Welleck et al., 2020 ) . Repetitive rollouts that reach the length limit receive reward 0, and the mask removes the gradient of such a rollout beyond 200 tokens past the repetition onset. blocks.en: We report the performance on the in-domain test set in Table 4 . Training improves SpecGen pass@4 from 0.7% to 82.7% for the 9B backbone and from 14.3% to 84.3% for the 27B backbone. AuXSpec -27B-RL surpasses every frontier model in both pass@1 and pass@4 on SpecGen and CodeGen, with 65.7% SpecGen pass@1 (vs. 57.7% for Claude-Opus-5, the strongest frontier model). The 9B RL model also outperforms every frontier model in SpecGen pass@1 (58.6%). On the repair tasks, the 27B RL model attains the best CodeGen-Repair pass@1 (88.1%) and stays within 2 points of the best result on the other metrics, while the 9B RL model surpasses most frontier models in SpecGen-Repair pass@1. To assess false positives of SpecGen acceptance, we prove the postcondition equivalence theorem for 99.2% of accepted RL outputs (Appendix H.4 ), and expert review confirms 90 of 100 sampled outputs, with all errors in the validity predicate (Appendix I.2 ).

To assess generalization beyond the synthesized data, we evaluate on Verina ( Ye et al., 2026a ) , a 189-problem manually curated benchmark with reference specifications, implementations and test cases.
Following the original evaluation, generated specifications must be sound and complete with respect to the reference specification on the test cases, and generated implementations must pass all positive test cases. AuXSpec -27B-RL outperforms all baselines in SpecGen pass@1 with 91.9% and trails the best baseline in pass@4 by 1.1 points (Table 5 ). On CodeGen, both RL models outperform all baselines, with pass@1 of 92.6% for the 9B model and 91.8% for the 27B model (vs. 56.6% for the best baseline). The 9B model also attains the highest pass@4 (98.4%).
Including the test cases in the prompt improves SpecGen pass@4 of both RL models from 90.5% to 96.8%, and the same test cases improve the pass@4 of frontier models by 5 to 24 points (Table 5 ).

blocks.en: 5.4 RL analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 RL分析

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning from the SFT models improves SpecGen pass@1 on AuXSpec -Test from 10.1% to 58.6% for the 9B model and from 18.7% to 65.7% for the 27B model (Table 4 and Figure 2 a ), and the gains transfer to Verina, where SpecGen pass@1 rises from 37.3% to 87.0% and from 57.3% to 91.9% (Table 5 and Figure 2 b ). The reward is computed on the synthesized problems only, yet Verina scores each specification against the reference specification on test cases absent from the prompt, so the policy learns faithfulness to the description beyond the frozen test cases.

blocks.en: Gains at pass@1 can also come from sharpening the sampling distribution, in which case the SFT model would catch up at large k k ( Yue et al., 2025 ) . SpecGen pass@256 of AuXSpec -27B-SFT (85.7%) stays below pass@8 of AuXSpec -27B-RL (88.2%), and the SFT model therefore needs more than 32 times the samples of the RL model to reach this pass rate. Within 256 samples, 33 of the 300 problems are solved only by the RL model and 1 only by the SFT model (Appendix E.3.3 ). The RL model is also token-efficient, requiring 20.3% of the output tokens per solved SpecGen sample of the most economical frontier model (Appendix D.2 ).

blocks.en: We utilize a progressive reward to assign fine-grained credit to partial progress. A binary reward assigns 0 to every rollout that fails any stage and provides no signal in groups where no sample passes. With fine-grained values, the group-relative advantage can distinguish better samples from worse ones within a group, which raises the probability of the better samples until the group saturates. Replaying the rollouts of the final runs confirms the denser signal. Groups without a passing rollout make up 37% of SpecGen groups for the 27B model and 47% for the 9B model and would be discarded by dynamic sampling under a binary reward ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , whereas the progressive reward yields nonzero variance in 87.9% and 86.2% of them (Appendix E.3.1 ). The rollouts shift accordingly and follow this group-relative credit. In the early stage, few CodeGen groups contain a fast and correct program, where slow but correct programs receive a positive advantage and grow (up to 67.4% of correct CodeGen rollouts of the 27B model). These slow programs then decrease gradually as fast programs appear (0.4% at the end), whereas the 9B model, which solves fewer CodeGen problems, ends with more of them (30.4%). Enumerative specifications show a similar pattern (17.0% to 2.8% of otherwise accepted specifications for the 27B model, Figure 2 c ).
blocks.zh: 我们利用渐进式的奖励,对部分进展给予优待。 二进制奖赏每一次推出时都会分配出0分,如果任何阶段都失败,在没有样本通过的组中不提供信号. 以精细的分泌值,群相关系优势可以区分出一个群内更好的样本和更糟糕的样本,这提高了更好的样本的概率,直到群相饱和. 重放最终跑道的展开,证实了更密集的信号. 未经过推广的团体占SpecGen组的37%,占SpecGen组的47%,并将在二进制奖励下通过动态抽样方式丢弃(Yu等人,2025年),而递进奖励在其中的87.9%和86.2%(附录E.3.1))。 推出工作相应转移,并遵循这一集团性信贷。 在早期,很少有CodeGen团体包含一个快而正确的程序,其中慢而正确的程序获得正优势并成长(高达27B模式正确推出的CodeGen的67.4%). 这些慢程序随即随着快程序出现而逐渐减少(末端为0.4%),而解决更少的代码Gen问题的9B模式则以更多的程序(30.4%)结束. 数字规格显示类似模式(为27B型号的另外接受规格的17.0%至2.8%,图2(c))。

blocks.en: The selection of the intermediate values relies on the reward dynamics, which we measure by replaying the training rollouts and recording the advantage of each stage in groups of different strength. For instance, correct but slow implementations are valued at 0.5, at which their advantage is positive only in groups with fewer than two passing rollouts, whereas at 0.8 it would stay positive with six passing rollouts of 16 (Appendix E.3.2 ). As CodeGen groups without a passing rollout fall from 44% to 0% over training ( Figure 4 b2 ), the mean advantage of slow implementations turns from + 0.10 +0.10 to − 0.17 -0.17 (steps 1–40 and 161–208). In SpecGen, 29% to 52% of groups remain without a passing rollout in each period ( Figure 4 b1 ), so hard SpecGen problems contribute a learning signal throughout training.
blocks.zh: 中间值的选择依赖于奖励动力,我们通过重放训练的展开和记录每个阶段在不同实力组的优势来测量. 例如,正确而缓慢的执行价值为0.5,在0.5中,其优点只在通过推广次数少于2次的群体中是积极的,而在0.8中,通过推广次数为16次(附录E.3.2)。 由于未通过推广的代码Gen组在培训后从44%降至0%(图4b2),缓慢实施的平均优势从+0.10+0.10到−0.17-0.17(步骤1-40和161-208)。 在SpecGen中,29%至52%的群体在每一期间都没有通过推广(图4 b1),因此,SpecGen的难题在整个培训过程中都提供了学习信号。

blocks.en: 6 Related work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Specification generation. Specification autoformalization translates requirements into formal specifications. Prior work studies postcondition generation from natural language ( Endres et al., 2024 ) , executable Python specifications ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and user intent in Dafny ( Lahiri, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 规格生成. 规格自动正规化将要求转化为正式规格. 前作研究从自然语言生成条件(Endres等,2024年),可执行Python规格(Chen等,2026年)和Dafny用户意图(Lahiri,2024年).

blocks.en: Training for specification generation. Training for program specification generation has concentrated on auto-active verification languages (Section 1 ). In Lean and Rocq, prior work checks a specification by proving each test case separately or by searching for counterexamples ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , and reinforcement learning from verifier feedback has targeted correctness proofs ( Li et al., 2026b ) but remains underexplored for specification generation ( Baksys et al., 2025 ) . Specification generators there are trained instead on synthesized and repaired examples, where a reference implementation labels tests, a proof attempt checks each labeled test, and LLM judgments guide refinement when proof automation is inconclusive ( Ye et al., 2026b ) . AuXSpec also labels tests with reference solutions, and relies on the test results of the executable postcondition to filter the training data and to define the reinforcement-learning reward (Section 2 ).
blocks.zh: 规格生成培训。 对程序规格生成的培训集中于自动使用核查语言(第1节)。 在Lean和Rocq, 先前的工作通过分别证明每个测试案例或寻找反实例来检查规格(Feng等人, 2026年),强化从核查反馈中学习具有针对性的正确性证明(Li等人, 2026年b),但对于规格生成仍然缺乏探索(Baksys等人, 2025年)。 那里的规格生成器接受了关于综合和修复实例的培训,在这些实例中,一个参考执行标签测试、一个验证尝试检查每个标签测试,以及LLM判断指导在验证自动化没有定论时加以完善(Ye等人,2026年b)。 AuXSpec还给测试贴上参考解决方案标签,并依靠可执行后条件的测试结果来过滤培训数据并定义强化学习奖励(第2节.

blocks.en: Executable specifications. The executability of specifications has long been debated in formal methods. Executable specifications can be validated against intended behavior by execution ( Kemmerer, 1985 ; Fuchs, 1992 ) , whereas declarative specifications are more expressive and independent of any algorithm ( Hayes & Jones, 1989 ) . Runtime assertion checking and property-based testing run contracts and properties as tests ( Meyer, 1992 ; Cheon & Leavens, 2002 ; Claessen & Hughes, 2000 ) , and proof assistants test conjectures before proving them ( Berghofer & Nipkow, 2004 ; Lean Community, 2024 ) . Boolean reflection pairs a proposition with a Boolean function and a proof that the two agree ( Gonthier & Mahboubi, 2010 ; Paraskevopoulou et al., 2015 ) . Executable counterparts can also be derived automatically from inductive relations in proof assistants, but the derivation covers a restricted class of relations, and users still write executable variants by hand and prove that the two agree ( Berghofer et al., 2009 ; Paraskevopoulou et al., 2022 ) . AuXSpec utilizes both sides of this trade-off, where we let models generate the executable variants, a step that previously required manual curation.
blocks.zh: 可执行规格。 规格的可执行性早已在正式方法中被辩论. 可执行的规格可以通过执行来验证意图行为(Kemmerer,1985;Fuchs,1992.),而声明式规格则更能表达并独立于任何算法(Hayes & Jones,1989.). 运行时间断言检查和基于财产的测试将合同和财产作为测试(Meyer,1992年;Cheon & Leavens,2002年;Claessen & Hughes,2000年),以及证明前的证明助理测试猜想(Berghofer & Nipkow,2004年;Lean社区,2024年)。 Boolean反射将一个带有Boolean函数的命题和两个都同意的证据相配(Gonthier & Mahboubi,2010; Paraskevopoulou等,2015.). 可执行对应方也可以自动从证明助理的诱导关系中推导出,但引出的内容涵盖了限定的一类关系,用户仍然用手书写可执行变体并证明两者同意(Berghofer等,2009;Paraskevopoulou等,2022.). AuXSpec利用这种取舍的两边,我们让模型生成可执行变体,这个步骤之前需要人工校正.

blocks.en:
Adjacent settings. Generating specifications for existing implementations utilizes a verifier to check the specification against the code but assumes the code is correct ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) .
In this setting, reinforcement learning has included executable checks on mutated-output tests in the reward ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Our SpecGen task instead starts from the problem description, input constraints and tests, without access to an implementation. Vericoding benchmarks evaluate the reverse task, generating implementations and proofs from a given formal specification ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Bursuc et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
相邻设置. 利用现有执行的规格,使用核查员对照编码检查规格,但假定编码正确(Chen等,2025;Yan等,2026)。
在此情况下,强化学习包括了对奖励中突变输出测试的可执行检查(黄等,2026. 我们的SpecGen任务则取而代之的是问题描述、输入限制和测试,而没有执行的机会。 验证基准评价反向任务,从某一正式规格中产生执行和证明(赵等,2026;Bursuc等,2026.).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented AuXSpec , a framework for training models to generate program specifications in Lean with execution-based feedback. AuXSpec pairs each declarative postcondition with an executable postcondition, and the postcondition equivalence theorem states that both agree on all valid inputs.
This allows us to evaluate specifications by directly executing test cases, without proving each case separately.
At the same time, we retain the declarative postcondition for formal correctness proofs.
With this format, we synthesize and release 3,037 LeetCode problems, each with a proved postcondition equivalence theorem.
The dataset includes AuXSpec -Test, a held-out benchmark of 300 expert-reviewed problems, all with proved correctness theorems.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了AuXSpec, 即一个培训模式框架, AuXSpec 将每个声明后条件与可执行后条件相配,而后条件等同定理则表示双方同意所有有效输入.
这使得我们可以通过直接执行测试案例来评估规格,而无需分别证明每个案例.
同时,我们保留了正式正确性证明的申报条件。
使用这种格式,我们合成并释放出3,037个LetCode问题,每个问题都有一个经过证明的后置等同定理.
数据集包括AuXSpec - Test,这是一个由300个专家审查的问题构成的搁置基准,所有数据都有经证明的正确性定理.

blocks.en:
Training on the synthesized data with an execution-based reinforcement-learning reward yields 9B and 27B models, and the 27B model surpasses all frontier models on AuXSpec -Test and outperforms all baselines in SpecGen pass@1 on the out-of-domain Verina benchmark.
Since the models are trained only on synthesized problems, the gains on Verina suggest that training with the reward improves faithfulness to the problem description beyond the test cases used in the reward.
We discuss the limitations of this work in Appendix J .
blocks.zh:
关于基于执行的强化学习奖励的综合数据的培训得出了9B和27B模型,27B模型超过了AuxSpec上的所有前沿模型 -- -- 测试和绩效超过了SpecGen中的所有基线,在域外Verina基准上通过@1。
由于这些模型只接受综合问题的培训,所以对Verina的好处表明,在奖励中使用的测试案例之外,对问题描述的忠诚程度有所提高。
我们在附录J中讨论了这项工作的局限性。

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning follows the settings of Table 9 for 1 epoch of the 13,637 tasks, which takes 434 steps for the 9B model and 208 steps for the 27B model. Rollout and training share the same GPUs, the Lean compilation pool runs on the CPUs of the same nodes, and the LLM judges are called through an external API. Rollouts longer than 12,288 tokens lose reward linearly, up to 1.0 at the limit of 16,384 tokens, following the soft overlong punishment of DAPO ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . The optimizer is AdamW with weight decay 0.01 and gradient clipping at 1.0, and the clipped surrogate adds dual clipping with constant 3.0 for negative advantages. The maximum prompt length is 8,192 tokens. A SpecGen rollout needs 12 tests and a CodeGen rollout 3, fewer for problems with fewer test rows. A rollout fails compilation when a declaration does not elaborate, a test cannot be evaluated, compilation exceeds the time limit, the compiler reports an error without a position, or the rollout contains sorry outside the two theorem statements, admit , axiom or native_decide . A rollout receives 0.3 when a judge call fails (Table 19 ). A rollout is repetitive when a 40-character n-gram, taken at a stride of 4 characters, occurs at least 20 times and fewer than 60% of the n-grams are distinct.

blocks.en: The LeetCode problems combine 2,869 problems of LeetCodeDataset ( Xia et al., 2025 ) with 746 free problems collected from the site after the dataset snapshot. Of the 746 problems, 263 pass a buildability filter that requires at least 3 examples and a Python function signature and excludes database, shell, concurrency and design problems. blocks.en: Each Codeforces and AtCoder problem, whose input is given from standard input, is rephrased into a typed function interface and admitted only when the reference solution still passes the stored tests through that interface. The rejected problems have stored tests that no reference solution reproduces (361), inputs that change under parsing and unparsing (259), several accepted answers (184), or other harness errors (20). Of the 1,440 AtCoder problems, conversion admits 892, an audit for descriptions that drop a stated condition and for examples that violate the stated constraints leaves 677, and freezing leaves 623. blocks.en: C.4 Expert iteration details
blocks.zh: C.4. 专家重复细节

blocks.en: Each round samples 1 refinement chain per problem and task from a fine-tuned Qwen3.8-27B. A chain generates an output, compiles the output, and repairs the output for up to 8 rounds, or 16 rounds in the last round of expert iteration. A chain is accepted under the criteria of Section 2 , and the reasons of each judge rejection enter the next repair round as review text. Expert iteration runs 3 rounds (Table 13 ). The first 2 rounds sample from the model fine-tuned on the LeetCode data, and the last round from the model fine-tuned on the data of the first 2 rounds and the Codeforces pipeline data. Accepted chains that pass at the first round become generation samples, and later rounds become repair samples or are rewritten into generation samples (Appendix C.3 ). blocks.en: Compile@ k k and Pass@ k k . We follow the standard definition of pass@ k k ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and define compile@ k k by analogy. For a problem with k k samples, compile@ k k is 1 when at least one sample compiles, and pass@ k k is 1 when at least one sample meets the acceptance criteria of Section 2 . The reported value is the mean over problems, which equals the unbiased estimator of pass@ k k ( Chen et al., 2021 ) since exactly k k samples are drawn per problem. Test case alignment compares the test lines of a sample with the frozen test cases regardless of layer headings, and Lean code blocks are extracted regardless of the capitalization of the language tag.

blocks.en: We measure output tokens per response and per solved sample (Table 14 ). AuXSpec -27B-RL requires the fewest output tokens per solved sample of all 13 models in the 4 generation settings. On SpecGen of AuXSpec -Test, it requires 80% fewer tokens per solved sample than GPT-5.6-Sol, the most economical frontier model (2.7K vs. 13.2K), while its pass@1 is 35.9 points higher (65.7% vs. 29.8%; Table 4 ). RL lowers the cost per solved SpecGen sample at both model sizes, as pass@1 grows faster than the response length (19.3K to 2.7K tokens for the 27B model and 36.0K to 11.0K for the 9B model).

blocks.en: RL changes the length of the reasoning trace in opposite directions at the 2 model sizes. Reasoning traces of the 27B model become shorter after RL, whereas reasoning traces of the 9B model become longer (1.6K to 0.4K and 1.7K to 4.6K thinking tokens per SpecGen response). blocks.en: D.4 Self-repair on ICPC-Eval
blocks.zh: D.4 ICC-Eval的自修

blocks.en: Besides generation, AuXSpec models are trained on the repair tasks (Section 2 ), which revise a rejected output from compiler and judge feedback. To assess the value of this ability, we evaluate AuXSpec -27B-RL on ICPC-Eval ( Xu et al., 2025b ) , a benchmark of competitive programming problems whose specifications require careful definitions. Of its 118 problems, we exclude 28 problems with multiple correct outputs, which a fixed expected output cannot judge, and 15 problems whose test cases exceed the length range of AuXSpec -Test, which leaves 75 problems. Following Refine@K of ICPC-Eval and the comparison of self-repair with i.i.d. sampling at an equivalent budget ( Olausson et al., 2024 ) , we compare 3 settings within a budget of k k model calls per problem: • Pass@ k k draws k k independent samples and is estimated from 16 samples. • Refine@ k k with compiler and judge feedback draws 1 sample and returns each rejected output with the compiler messages or the judge findings, in the format of the repair tasks, until an output is accepted or k k calls are made. • Refine@ k k with compiler feedback only follows the same chain and stops at the first output that compiles. All settings sample at temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95 with at most 32,768 generated tokens, and the acceptance criteria (Section 2 ) score every output.

blocks.en: Motivation. An early supervised fine-tuning run of Qwen3.5-9B compiles 5.05% of the 1,208 SpecGen samples and 3.8% of all 3,596 samples on the held-out problems. Classifying the first compiler error of the failed samples shows that 40.8% misuse Mathlib declarations, through application type mismatches (17.3%), invalid fields or projections (14.7%) and type mismatches (8.7%), and 65.2% once unknown identifiers (11.6%) and missing instances (12.8%) are counted. With retrieved declaration names in 58% of the answers, the failures come from the use of Mathlib.

blocks.en: Corpus. Synthesis augments prompts with Mathlib declarations retrieved for the problem (Appendix G.1.2 ), and across the 3,109 LeetCode problems the retrievals cover 1,381 distinct declarations, of which 1,298 are found in the pinned Mathlib source. These declarations come from 411 files, and we take all declarations of those files rather than the retrieved ones alone, which yields 26,936 declaration heads. The heads are rewritten with DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) into English lessons that state the content, the application, the occasion and the contrast of a declaration, which follows the rewriting of raw corpora into reading-comprehension text ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) and textbook-style synthetic corpora ( Gunasekar et al., 2023 ) . blocks.en: Training and result. Adding problems to supervised fine-tuning improves pass@4 more than continued pretraining does (Table 17 ). Continued pretraining minimizes the next-token loss on the corpus, ℒ CPT ( θ ) = − 𝔼 u ∼ ℳ ∑ t log π θ ( u t ∣ u < t ) , \mathcal{L}_{\text{CPT}}(\theta)=-\,\mathbb{E}_{u\sim\mathcal{M}}\sum_{t}\log\pi_{\theta}(u_{t}\mid u_{<t}), (3) for 2 epochs, 92 steps, on Qwen3.5-9B base with learning rate 5e-6 and sequence length 16,384, and supervised fine-tuning follows on 4,826 rows from 1,631 problems. Domain corpora of this kind help on downstream tasks ( Gururangan et al., 2020 ) and formal provers are pretrained on Lean and mathematics before fine-tuning ( Azerbayev et al., 2024 ; Xin et al., 2025 ) , yet the benefit of continued pretraining is not universal ( Shi & Lipani, 2023 ) . Here continued pretraining improves SpecGen pass@4 from 8.2 to 9.8 and pass@4 over the 4 tasks from 26.4 to 27.4, whereas adding 1,056 problems, 3,167 rows, to supervised fine-tuning improves the same 2 numbers to 13.7 and 30.2. The corpus loss falls from 1.03 to 0.69 with held-out perplexity 2.03. The corpus is therefore fit while the downstream gain stays at 1.0 point, the distance between document perplexity and downstream use reported for knowledge injection through continued pretraining ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) . Content memorized from a corpus becomes usable after many representations of the same content ( Allen-Zhu & Li, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , and each of the 26,936 declarations appears in 1 lesson here. Lessons state the meaning of declarations, whereas a compiling specification requires declarations composed into terms that the elaborator accepts, and added problems carry test cases and judges that label samples of that composition. Later rounds therefore put the effort into data.

blocks.en: The final recipe for AuXSpec -9B-RL and AuXSpec -27B-RL combines the progressive reward of Eq. ( 1 ), the self-repair buffer, the overlong penalty and the mask on repetitive rollouts on the clipped surrogate of DAPO with batch-normalized advantages (Section 4.3 ), and adds the end-of-sequence penalty for the 27B model. The runs on the 9B model develop the recipe, and both models train for 1 epoch, 434 steps for the 9B model and 208 steps for the 27B model, with the settings of Table 9 . Both runs remain stable through the epoch, with 0.12% and 0.60% of rollouts repetitive and 0.13% and 0.11% malformed for the 27B and 9B models. The reported models are the final checkpoints, and SpecGen pass@1 on AuXSpec -Test still rises over the last evaluated checkpoints, from 54.3% at step 400 to 58.6% for the 9B model and from 61.3% at step 200 to 65.7% for the 27B model. The subsections below analyze the reward stages, the reward dynamics and pass@ k k .

blocks.en: Table 19 lists the reward and the fraction of rollouts of each outcome. Each rule against reward hacking closes a shortcut that the stages would otherwise reward. A test that calls no declaration of the output, such as #guard true , passes without testing the output, and counting only tests that call a declaration keeps the test stages meaningful. An escape hatch, the sorry and admit tactics, an axiom declaration or the native_decide tactic, lets an output compile without the checks that later stages assume. Special-casing the test inputs, excluding a test value from the validity predicate and copying the given test cases into the implementation all pass the test stages without solving the problem and receive 0. Altering a given test case lets a rollout pass the test stages against a different expected output and receives 0.1. A test that cannot run would otherwise earn the test execution credit of a test that ran and failed. An unchanged repair would keep the credit of the stages the failed input already passes. The non-tautology stage precedes the overall quality stage, the order in which evaluation runs the judges.

blocks.en: The partial credit separates accepted outputs by form. The non-tautology judge classifies a specification as declarative, enumerative or tautological. A declarative specification states the condition of the problem and is sound and complete: every answer that satisfies the specification is correct, and every correct answer satisfies the specification. An enumerative specification states the same condition over a candidate list that the specification constructs, such as all sublists of the input, instead of quantifying over the candidate type. A tautological specification replaces the condition with an algorithm for the answer, which is the role of the implementation. The implementation judge marks a correct CodeGen implementation as slow when the implementation takes more than about 10 7 10^{7} steps on the largest admitted input and a method faster by more than a logarithmic factor exists, known as a slow positive ( Li et al., 2022 ) . Appendix K.3 lists both prompts.

blocks.en: We analyze the group-relative advantage ( Shao et al., 2024 ) before batch normalization. Replaying the training rollouts with the value of one outcome changed shows how the value sets this advantage ( Figure 4 a1 and 4 a2 ). Failures that attempt to score unfaithfully are shortcuts rather than progress. For instance, tautological specifications restate algorithms instead of specifying problems, and failed test case alignments usually rewrite the given test cases. Such unfaithful attempts should be discouraged in every group. Higher values, though well below the full reward of 1, still assign these failures positive advantages in groups without correct rollouts, whereas replaying at 0.1 shows advantages that are negative and below those of faithful attempts in almost every group (Table 20 ).
blocks.zh: 我们在批量正常化前分析集团相对优势(Shao等,2024年). 重放一个结果的价值变化的训练推广显示该价值如何设定这一优势(图4a1和图4a2)。 企图不诚实地得分的失败是捷径而不是进步。 例如:同义规范重述算法而不是指定问题,失败的测试大小写对齐通常会重写给定的测试大小写. 每一个集团都应劝阻这种不忠的企图。 更高的价值观虽然远远低于1的全额奖励,但仍在未正确推出的团体中赋予这些失败的积极优势,而重放0.1的优势则显示出几乎每个团体的负面优势并低于忠实尝试的优势(表20)。

blocks.en: Based on observation, some attempts make partial progress that is correct in substance but not yet in the perfect form. For instance, 1) enumerative specifications already state the correct condition and only need to be rewritten declaratively, and 2) slow implementations are already correct and only need faster algorithms. Binary judges also classify enumerative specifications poorly. An intermediate reward for partial progress refines sparse signals into fine-grained rewards. When rewards are low, like SpecGen in the early steps, partial progress rewards small improvements of failing attempts, while once correct rollouts are common, declarative specifications and fast implementations are assigned higher advantages.
blocks.zh: 根据观察,有些尝试取得了部分进展,在实质上是正确的,但尚未达到完美的形式。 例如,(1) 列举性规格已经说明正确的条件,只需以声明方式重写;(2) 缓慢的执行已经正确,只需要更快的算法。 二等法官对列举规格的分类也很差。 对部分进展的中间奖励将稀有的信号精炼成精细的奖励. 当奖励率低时,如SpecGen在早期的步骤,部分进步奖励失败尝试的微小改进,而一旦正确的推出是常见的,宣告性规格和快执行则被赋予更高的优势.

blocks.en: By replaying the rollouts, we fix intermediate values at which partial progress receives positive advantages in groups with few correct rollouts and negative ones in groups with many. A slow implementation at 0.5 turns negative from 2 passing rollouts of 16, compared with 6 at 0.8, and an enumerative specification at 0.4 turns negative from 3, compared with 14 when valued like a full-score answer. As the policy improves, the advantage of partial progress turns from positive to negative ( Figure 4 b2 and 4 c2 ). CodeGen groups without a passing rollout fall from 44% in steps 1 to 40 to 0% in steps 161 to 208, and the mean advantage of slow implementations falls from + 0.10 +0.10 to − 0.17 -0.17 over the same periods. SpecGen keeps 29% to 52% of groups without a passing rollout in each period, where quality rejections keep a mean advantage near 0 with both signs ( Figure 4 c1 ). Partial progress thus provides intermediate supervision that keeps the reward informative throughout training (Table 21 ).

blocks.en: A key question for RL with verifiable rewards is whether it expands the set of problems a model can solve or only raises the probability of solutions that the starting model already samples. Pass@ k k at large k k separates the two, since a starting model that catches up at large k k solves the same problems with more samples ( Yue et al., 2025 ) . Prolonged RL has been reported to expand the set most where the starting model is weak ( Liu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 具有可核查回报的RL的一个关键问题是,它是否扩展了一个模型能够解决的一组问题,还是仅仅提高了启动模型已经取样的解决方案的概率. Pass@ k k at group k k 将两者分开, 因为一个在大 k k 中捕捉到的起步模型用更多的样本解决了同样的问题( Yue et al., 2025). 据报告,在启动模式薄弱的地方,延长RL以扩大设定(Liu等,2025年)。

blocks.en: We compare AuXSpec -27B-RL with AuXSpec -27B-SFT, the starting model of RL, at temperature 0.6 and top- p p 0.95. Pass@64, pass@128 and pass@256 count a problem as solved when any of 64, 128 or 256 samples passes, and additional samples are drawn only for problems not yet solved.

blocks.en: E.4 On-policy distillation
blocks.zh: E.4. 联合国 政策提炼

blocks.en: To transfer the capability of AuXSpec -27B-SFT, the strongest of our models on AuXSpec -Test, to the smaller AuXSpec -9B-SFT, we apply on-policy distillation (OPD) and OPD within reinforcement learning ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025a ) , but neither improves the student model. OPD, with the k3 estimator in the advantage, suffers from mode collapse, where the student model concentrates on the decidable form of the executable postcondition, leading to a compile rate of 2.0% without compiler feedback. SpecGen pass@4 drops from 24.3 to 5.3 while CodeGen changes by at most 3 points. blocks.en: Attribution. We attribute the SpecGen drop to estimator bias, which lowers entropy throughout training, to mode collapse, which moves probability onto a form that often fails to compile, and to teacher redundancy, which makes the teacher term uninformative about sample success. 1. Estimator bias. With k 3 k_{3} inside the advantage, the policy gradient is a biased estimate of the reverse KL gradient that also raises the forward KL, and this configuration is reported to collapse training ( Shah et al., 2026 ) . The entropy decline of Figure 9 matches this bias. 2. Mode collapse. The pipeline sets the decidable form as the first executable postcondition and replaces the form through instance synthesis or a separate definition when compilation fails (Section 3.1 ), and the form covers 35.5% of synthesized problems as a result. Evaluation scores single samples without compiler feedback. We conjecture that the mode-seeking reverse KL ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) moves probability onto this frequent form, including on problems where the form does not compile. The student adopts the form in 54.6% of samples on problems where the teacher never adopts it. OPD therefore amplifies the form beyond teacher usage. 3. Teacher redundancy. Teacher models with higher scores help only when offering capabilities beyond the experience of the student ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Teacher and student are fine-tuned on the same data, and although OPD within RL adds the fine-grained reward of reinforcement learning, the teacher term stays uninformative about which samples succeed. Identical tokenizers and chat templates rule out a format mismatch, and on problems the teacher fails, the student stops at the failing stage of the teacher no more often after OPD than before.

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of each component, we construct 3 variants of the RL recipe of AuXSpec -9B, each removing one component, and train them from AuXSpec -9B-SFT with the same training prompts, order and seed: • w/o test execution compiles each rollout without its test cases, so no test case is executed, and keeps all judge stages. • w/o LLM judges assigns the top reward to every rollout that passes the test cases. • w/o self-repair fills every batch slot with a new training prompt. The variant without self-repair therefore consumes training prompts faster, so each variant is compared with AuXSpec -9B-RL after approximately the same number of training prompts rather than at the same step (Table 26 ). Evaluation follows Table 4 .

blocks.en: LLM judges. Without LLM judges in the reward, the model exploits the reward by restating the given test cases as the specification. We note that the training reward keeps increasing, while SpecGen pass@1 on AuXSpec -Test reaches its highest value around step 100 and then decreases ( Figure 11 c1 ). The gap between the 2 therefore widens over training (84.7% of SpecGen rollouts accepted in steps 141–150 vs. 20.0% pass@1 at step 150, down from 35.8% at step 100). Tautological specifications account for a growing part of the evaluation samples (1.9% at step 50 vs. 58.8% at step 150). On Verina, these specifications pass the test cases given in the prompt but fail without them (88.4% vs. 52.0% SpecGen pass@1 at step 150).
blocks.zh: LLM评委. 在奖励中没有LLM评委,模型利用奖励,将给定的测试案例重述为规格. 我们注意到,培训奖励不断增加,而SpecGen在AuXSpec-Test上通过@1,在100级左右达到最高值,然后下降(图11 c1)。 因此,两者之间的差距大于培训(第141-150步中接受的SpecGen推出的84.7%对第150步中通过@1的20.0%,低于第100步中35.8%)。 陶道规格在评价样本中占越来越大的比例(第50步为1.9%,第150步为58.8%)。 在Verina,这些规格通过即时的测试案例,但没有这些案例(88.4%对52.0%的SpecGen通过@1步骤150)。

blocks.en: Test execution. Without test execution in the reward, the reward accepts implementations that the test cases would reject. About half of the CodeGen rollouts pass the remaining stages early in training (49.7% vs. 19.7% of CodeGen rollouts accepted in steps 41–50 without and with test execution), while CodeGen pass@1 on AuXSpec -Test improves slowly ( Figure 11 b2 ). After approximately the same number of training prompts the variant falls behind AuXSpec -9B-RL in both tasks (34.4% vs. 65.0% CodeGen and 24.3% vs. 34.9% SpecGen pass@1 after 4,111 and 4,162 prompts). The gap in CodeGen persists at step 150 even though the variant has drawn more training prompts (37.6% vs. 65.0% after 4,796 vs. 4,162 prompts; Table 26 ). Repair remains comparable to the other runs (65.8% SpecGen-Repair pass@1 at step 150), so the variant falls behind in generating a correct output from scratch. The judges alone cannot check the behavior of an implementation, and test execution keeps the reward accurate.

blocks.en: Self-repair. Without self-repair every batch slot holds a new training prompt. The variant therefore consumes training prompts faster and outperforms AuXSpec -9B-RL at the same step (43.1% vs. 34.9% SpecGen pass@1 at steps 150 and 140 after 6,334 vs. 4,162 prompts). AuXSpec -9B-RL outperforms it in both generation and repair even after fewer training prompts (21.8% vs. 14.7% SpecGen and 54.3% vs. 45.8% SpecGen-Repair pass@1 after 2,149 and 2,396 prompts). After about 6.2K prompts it still outperforms the variant in generation (46.7% vs. 43.1% SpecGen pass@1; Table 26 ). Training without repair tasks is thus a viable recipe when new problems are plentiful.
blocks.zh: 自我修养. 没有自我修复,每个批次的档次都会有新的培训时间。 因此,该变体在同一步骤上消耗了培训提示器,并且超过了AuXSpec-9B-RL(43.1%对34.9%SpecGen通过@1,在6 334对4 162的提示器之后为150和140步)。 AuXSpec -9B-RL在生成和修复方面都超过了它,即使培训提示较少(21.8%对14.7%SpecGen和54.3%对45.8%SpecGen-Repair通过2,149和2,396提示之后). 在大约6.2K提示之后,它仍然在生成时超过了变体(46.7%对43.1% SpecGen通过@1;表26)。 因此,在新问题充斥时,没有修理任务的培训是一种可行的办法。

blocks.en: The repair tasks are designed for settings in which a model revises its output from feedback over several rounds, such as long-horizon verification and collaboration between agents. Refinement from compiler and judge feedback is part of the training objective, and the model also refines its specifications at test time: on ICPC-Eval, refine@16 reaches 82.7% of the problems, compared with 61.3% for pass@16 (Appendix D.4 ).
blocks.zh: 修理任务是针对一个模型根据几轮反馈修改其产出的设置设计的,如长视距核查和代理商之间的协作。 完善编译器和评委反馈是培训目标的一部分,该模型在测试时也会完善其规格:在IPC-Eval上,精炼@16达到了82.7%的问题,而通过@16时为61.3%(附录D.4).

blocks.en: G.1.1 Test cases
blocks.zh: G.1.1 (中文(简体) ). 测试案例

blocks.en: For each of 3,109 problems (719 easy, 1,622 medium, 768 hard), we screen the stored examples and propose negative test cases, invalid inputs and incorrect outputs beside the positive test cases. Invalid inputs are proposed by category (a value just outside a stated bound, a size outside the stated range, a container of the wrong shape, a broken structural invariant, parameters invalid only together, a value outside the stated domain), and incorrect outputs by category (a near miss, a suboptimal feasible answer, an unattainable answer, the answer under a relaxed constraint, an output of the wrong shape, a degenerate answer). Benchmarks store negative test cases beside positive ones ( Ye et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026b ) , since a specification that accepts correct outputs on the given examples can still accept incorrect outputs ( Endres et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 对于3 109个问题(719个容易、1 622个中型、768个硬),我们筛选所储存的例子,除了正试验案例外,还提出负试验案例、无效输入和不正确的输出。 无效的输入按类别提出(一个值就在声明约束之外,一个大小在声明范围之外,一个形状错误的容器,一个结构变量断裂,参数只无效在一起,一个值在声明域之外),以及不正确的输出按类别提出(一个接近错失,一个不理想的可行答案,一个无法实现的答案,一个宽松的制约下的答案,一个错误形状的输出,一个堕落的答案). 基准在阳性试验病例之外储存阴性试验病例(Ye等人,2026a; Ye等,2026b),因为接受特定实例中正确产出的规格仍然可以接受不正确的产出(Endres等,2024.).

blocks.en: A proposed incorrect output is admitted when the reference solution, run on the proposed valid input, returns an output that is not a reordering of the proposed output. Invalid inputs are proposed together with the violated constraint and are dropped on coinciding with a valid example of the problem. Cases too large for compiled evaluation and cases whose stored answer is null are refused before any model call, with the measured thresholds in Appendix G.5 .
blocks.zh: 在使用拟议有效输入的参考解决方案返回不是对拟议产出重新排序的产出时,一个拟议不正确的产出被认可。 无效的投入与被违反的制约一起被提出,与问题的有效例子同时被放弃。 在任何模型调用之前,对无法进行汇编评价的案件和储存的答案无效的案件一律拒绝,附录G.5中为衡量阈值。

blocks.en: The 27,981 test cases, 9 per problem, are assembled into 18 #guard commands per problem, one per test case and layer of Table 7 , with each positive test case reused at L1 a , L2 a , L3, and L4. A #guard command runs compiled code, and a passed test case relies on the compiler and runtime as trusted base, the same as native_decide . For the test cases, we store the provenance (public example or synthesized) and the admission round. A test case judged wrong is replaced by a held-back test case at most once per problem.
blocks.zh: 27 981个测试案例,每个问题9个,被集合成18个#守护命令,每个测试案例1个,表7层,每个正测试案例在L1 a,L2 a,L3和L4重用. #guard命令运行被编译的代码,通过测试的大小写依赖于编译器和运行时间作为可信赖的基数,与本地决定相同. 对于测试案例,我们存储出处(公用例子或合成)和入院回合. 判断错误的测试案例被每个问题最多一次的后置测试案例所取代.

blocks.en: Analysis. The frozen test cases, negative test cases included, are shown to the generation model, and the negative test cases act as part of the problem statement rather than as a hidden filter. Of 3,276 specification candidates tested at L1 a and L1 b , 8 (0.24%) fail only at L1 b , and of 3,195 executable postconditions tested at L2 a and L2 b , 4 (0.13%) fail only at L2 b . The 4 failures at L2 b have one cause, a lossy output decoder in the specification, such as a tree decoder that drops children below null nodes. The 8 failures at L1 b fall on 5 problems, and in 4 of the 5 problems the frozen invalid input is in fact valid. Repair narrowed the precondition to reject that input in all 5 problems. Frozen test values keep test cases from adapting to a wrong specification, and these 5 preconditions are the only adaptation in the opposite direction.
blocks.zh: 分析。 冷冻测试案例,包括阴性测试案例向生成模型显示,而阴性测试案例作为问题陈述的一部分而不是隐藏过滤器. 在L1a和L1b测试的3 276个规格候选人中,8个(0.24%)只在L1b测试失败,在L2a和L2b测试的3 195个可执行条件中,4个(0.13%)只在L2b测试失败。 L2b的4个故障有一个原因,在规格中是一个损失的输出解码器,例如将孩子降入无节点以下的树解码器. L1b的8个故障落在了5个问题上,在5个问题中的4个问题中被冻结的无效输入实际上是有效的. 修复缩小了在所有5个问题上拒绝这种投入的先决条件。 被冻结的测试值使测试案例无法适应错误的规格,这5个先决条件是相反方向的唯一适应.

blocks.en: Screening. Before any model call, test cases are filtered by size and by null answers. A test case containing a list or string longer than 128 items is refused, since a case is frozen as a literal that compiled evaluation builds item by item. We cap compilation at 600 seconds on the Lean server and observe that a test case exceeding the cap terminates the serving REPL. The threshold was measured over the stored test cases, and any threshold between 102 and 185 items refuses the same test cases. A case whose stored answer is null is refused in the layers that read an answer, since the source dataset stores null wherever the answer is a mutated argument, and a null true answer makes each negative built from the null answer meaningless.
blocks.zh: 筛选 在任何模型调用之前,测试案例会按照大小和无效答案进行过滤. 包含超过128项的列表或字符串的测试案例被拒绝,因为一个案例被冻结为逐项汇编评价的文字。 我们在精益服务器上以600秒的速度编译,并观察到超过上限的测试案例会终止服务REPL. 临界值是用储存的试验箱衡量的,102至185个物项之间的任何阈值都拒绝同样的试验箱。 在读出一个答案的分层中拒绝一个被存储的答案为无效的案件,因为只要答案是变异的参数,源数据集就存储无效,而一个无效的真实答案使得从无效答案中构建出来的每个负数都变得毫无意义.

blocks.en: G.1.2 Library retrieval
blocks.zh: G.1.2 图书馆检索

blocks.en: Models reference library declarations absent from the pinned library version ( Chakraborty et al., 2025 ) . Typed queries against Mathlib, for a definition, a theorem, or an instance, are generated together with one sentence stating the use the specification has for the answer, and relevance is judged against that sentence. Search candidates are deduplicated, elaborated with #check against the pinned toolchain, and judged for relevance by an LLM given the problem description. Specification synthesis is augmented with the declarations admitted by the relevance judge, 4.2 per problem, each with a checked signature and a one-sentence reason from the LLM. Appendix G.5 reports the counts at each step.
blocks.zh: 标注的图书馆版本没有模型参考图书馆声明(Chakraborty等人,2025年)。 对Mathlib的打字查询,为定义,定理或实例,与一句一起生成,说明规格对答案的用法,关联性根据该句判断. 搜索对象被切换,用#检查被绑住的工具链来细化,并根据问题描述通过LLM判断其相关性. 随着相关法官的承认、每个问题4.2个声明、每个问题都有经核对的签名和LLM的一个判决理由,规格综合得到了加强。 附录G.5报告每一步骤的计数。

blocks.en: Analysis. Elaboration keeps declarations that exist only in newer Mathlib versions out of specification synthesis (Table 28 ). 23,608 queries (14,888 definition, 5,052 theorem, 3,668 instance) produced 92,104 candidates. Of the elaborated declarations, 5.4% were absent from the pinned Mathlib, and review dropped 10.0% of the reviewed candidates. Of the 13,191 stored declarations, specification synthesis of the 3,037 problems received 12,876, 4.2 per problem, with 131 problems receiving none. The absent declarations originate in a search index built on the latest Mathlib, while synthesis compiles against the pinned version. Retrieved declarations do not change the first compilation. Specifications that reference a retrieved declaration by the full name compile at the first attempt in 83.2% of 1,871 problems, and the other specifications in 83.9% of 1,032.
blocks.zh: 分析。 详细化使仅存在于较新版的Mathlib版本的申报脱离规格综合(表28)。 23 608个查询(14 888个定义,5 052个定理,3 668个实例)产生了92 104个候选人。 在详细申报中,5.4%没有参加标注的Mathlib,审查所审查的候选人减少了10.0%。 在所储存的13,191份申报中,3,037个问题的规格综合得到12,876份,每个问题4.2份,131个问题没有收到。 缺席声明源于一个基于最新 Mathlib 的搜索索引,而合成则根据被绑定的版本来编译. 获取的声明不会改变第一份汇编。 在1 871个问题的83.2%的首次尝试中,参考检索到的全名声明的规格,在1 032个问题的83.9%中,参考其他规格。

blocks.en: G.2 Specifications
blocks.zh: G.2 规格

blocks.en: Planning. A type plan fixes the declaration names and one type per parameter, with a conversion function wherever the stored value has a different type. The postcondition is then planned regardless of decidability, which keeps computation out of the postcondition. A frozen test value is printed once as the expression used by all test layers to prevent models from altering the value.
blocks.zh: 规划。 一个类型计划会固定申报名称和每个参数的一个类型,只要存储值有不同的类型,就具有转换功能. 然后,无论可决定性如何,都要规划后期条件,这样就可以不计算后期条件。 被冻结的测试值被印出一次,作为所有测试层使用的表达来防止模型改变值.

blocks.en: Formalization.
blocks.zh: 正规化.

blocks.en:
Each component is generated separately and compiled with the accepted components. The #guard commands of the layers are generated from the expressions the plan fixed, and each command is accepted at the first passing check in the order shape, verbatim expression, token-level expression, and judge review of equivalence. The shape check admits one command per test case, attached to the declaration of that layer and with the polarity of the test case.
The expression check compares the tokens of the printed expression, which keeps whitespace from merging 2 values.
blocks.zh:
每个部分单独产生,并与公认的部分一起编译. 分层的#守护命令由计划所设定的表达式产生,每个命令在第一次通过检查时以顺序形状,逐字记录,符号级表达式,以及法官对等值的审查被接受. 外形检查每个测试案例接受一个指令,附在该层的申报上,并带有测试案例的极性.
表达式检查比较了打印表达式的符号,它使白空间无法将2个值合并.

blocks.en: Executable postcondition. The executable postcondition is first set to the decidable form of the postcondition, and the file is compiled. When no decidability instance is derived, a model supplies instances from the compiler diagnostics for up to 3 rounds. When the supplied instances still fail to elaborate, a separate definition is generated. Only a separate definition can disagree with the postcondition, which the L2 a and L2 b test cases detect on the tested outputs and the postcondition equivalence theorem excludes on all valid inputs. Appendix G.5 reports the counts by form.
blocks.zh: 可执行的附加条件 。 可执行后条件首先被设定为后条件的可裁定形式,文件被编译. 当不能得出可解性实例时,一个模型会从编译器诊断中提供可达3发的实例. 当所提供实例仍未详细阐述时,将生成一个单独的定义。 只有单独的定义才能不同意后置条件,L2 a和L2 b测试案例在被测试的输出上检测到后置条件等同定理排除了所有有效输入. 附录G.5按表格报告清点情况。

blocks.en: Judges. The postcondition judge is given the problem description, the constraints, and the postcondition source. A rejection quotes a sentence of the description and names an output that the postcondition admits and the problem excludes. The executable postcondition judge is given the constraints, the accepted precondition and postcondition, and the executable postcondition, and a rejection names a valid input with a witness or counterexample that the executable postcondition misses or wrongly admits. The tautology judge rejects a postcondition that computes the output. Problems whose natural statement is the transformation itself are labeled in advance by a majority vote of 3 classifier calls, and the label exempts the problem from the tautology judge. The rejected component is repaired with the named error, or replanned for an error in the plan.
blocks.zh: 诸法官. 后条件法官得到的问题描述、限制和后条件来源。 拒绝引用了描述的句子,并取出一个附加条件所承认和问题所排除的产出的名称. 可执行后条件法官被赋予限制条件,被接受的前提条件和后条件,以及可执行后条件,被否决者与可执行后条件错失或错误承认的证人或反例共同命名为有效输入. 同义法官拒绝计算输出的后置条件. 其自然语句为转换本身的问题,事先以3个分级调用者的多数票标出标签,标签将问题免除给同义法官. 被拒绝的组件会用命名错误来修复,或者因计划中的错误而重新规划.

blocks.en: G.2.1 Example problems
blocks.zh: G.2.1 实例问题

blocks.en: We illustrate the format with problem 1955 Count Number of Special Subsequences from AuXSpec -Test (Figures 13 and 15a ). In this problem, we are given an array over { 0 , 1 , 2 } \{0,1,2\} and need to count, modulo 10 9 + 7 10^{9}+7 , the subsequences of the form 0 a ​ 1 b ​ 2 c 0^{a}1^{b}2^{c} with a , b , c ≥ 1 a,b,c\geq 1 . The postcondition states the result as the size of the set of index sets whose selected elements take this form. The executable postcondition enumerates all subsets of the indices, a brute-force computation that finishes on the short test inputs. The implementation counts in 1 pass with 3 counters, for subsequences of 0s, of 0s followed by 1s, and of 0s, 1s and 2s, since an element either extends or skips the subsequences counted so far. Since neither specification mentions the counters, the correctness theorem relates the recurrence to the set of index sets.

blocks.en:
For this problem, a natural postcondition characterizes the valid index sets S S as exactly those that select a subsequence of the form 0 + ​ 1 + ​ 2 + 0^{+}1^{+}2^{+} from the input.
This characterization is not directly executable, since it ranges over arbitrary finite sets of natural numbers.
However, every relevant index set is contained in the input indices. The executable postcondition therefore enumerates 2 { 0 , … , input.length − 1 } 2^{\{0,\ldots,\text{input.length}-1\}} and counts the subsets satisfying the same property.
The two formulations describe the same relation but are not definitionally identical in Lean, so the postcondition equivalence theorem connects the logical characterization with the bounded enumeration.

对于这个问题,一个自然的后置条件将有效的索引S设定为选择表单的子序列的S 0+1+2+0+1+2+0+1+2+=== 从输入。
这种定性不能直接执行,因为它超越任意的有限自然数组。
然而,每一套相关的指数都包含在输入指数中。 因此,可执行的后置条件列出2 { 0, ..., 输入. 长 - 1 } 2\\ 0,\ ldots,\ text{ input. long} - 1\ 并计算满足同一属性的子集 。

blocks.en: We illustrate the decidable form with problem 523 Continuous Subarray Sum from AuXSpec -Test (Figures 15a , 16 and 16 ). In this problem, we are given an array of non-negative integers and a positive integer k k and need to decide whether some contiguous subarray of length at least 2 sums to a multiple of k k . The postcondition states that the result is true exactly when there exist 2 indices and an integer multiplier n n such that the subarray between the indices sums to n ⋅ k n\cdot k .
blocks.zh: 我们用AuXSpec试验(图15a、16和16)中的问题523连续分数来说明可决定的形式。 在此问题上,我们得到了一系列非负整数和正整数kk,并且需要决定长度的某个相接子阵列至少2个和多个kk. 后置条件说明,当存在2个指数和一个整数乘以n时,结果就是真实的,这样,这些指数的总和之间的子阵列就是n-k-n-cdot k。

blocks.en: The executable postcondition applies decide to the postcondition, which compiles only when type class resolution finds a Decidable instance for the unfolded proposition. The existential over natural-number indices and an integer multiplier has no such instance as stated, since the quantifiers range over unbounded domains. The pipeline therefore synthesizes a type class instance that bounds both indices by the length of the array, replaces the multiplier by integer divisibility, and proves the bounded proposition equivalent to the original with decidable_of_iff . Type class resolution then assembles the executable postcondition from this instance and the library instances for bounded quantifiers and divisibility, so the executable postcondition agrees with the postcondition by construction (Appendix H.2 ). The implementation, omitted from the figure, scans prefix sums modulo k k with a map from each remainder to the earliest prefix index at which the remainder occurs, and the correctness theorem relates this scan to the existential of the postcondition.

blocks.en: The specification judges rarely reject, and the errors that pass all checks are in the meaning of the specification. Each verdict in Table 29 corresponds to a distinct component that compiles and passes the test layers of the component. The specification judges reject 1.7% to 3.8% of the verdicts, and all rejected problems are accepted after repair. The errors that proving or human review later found had all passed the test layers and the judge of the erroneous component. In 2 problems a correct rejection led to a repair that introduced the error found by review, and in 1 problem the judge accepted on a second reading the defect that the judge had named.

blocks.en: The decidable form is reliable where the postcondition quantifies over bounded types (Figure 17 ). The decidable form serves 1,079 of the 3,037 problems (35.5%). Of the other 1,958 problems, 1,343 have postconditions that quantify over unbounded types, 319 were synthesized before instance synthesis was added, 287 fail instance synthesis for 3 rounds, 6 remain unexplained, and 3 are routed to the decidable form but keep a separate definition in the final file. Where the decidable form applies, the executable postcondition passes all checks at the first attempt in 772 of 787 problems (98.1%), compared with 1,178 of 2,250 (52.4%) for separately generated executable postconditions. Missing instances arise from the decidable form. The pipeline first sets the executable postcondition to decide applied to the postcondition, which compiles only when Lean finds a decidability instance for the postcondition. A postcondition that quantifies over an unbounded type (e.g., over all natural numbers or all lists) has no computable instance as stated, and instance synthesis fails, for example on add-digits, where no decidability instance can be synthesized for a postcondition that quantifies over all digit roots d d .

blocks.en: G.3 Implementation
blocks.zh: G.3 执行

blocks.en: Implementation planning is given the accepted specification as read-only text and selects an algorithm with cost argument, listing specification definitions to call and definitions to replace with reason. The plan is checked before generation for a termination argument based on a decreasing quantity of the input, a stated cost consistent with the approach and the input bounds, a replacement justified by cost or by a different question, and an algorithm that computes the answer, without search over candidates. Beyond the properties in Section 3.1 , the implementation judge reports computations already available in the specification.
blocks.zh: 实施规划被赋予了公认的规格作为只读文本,并选择一个带有成本论证的算法,列出规格定义以调用,定义以理性取而代之. 在生成计划之前,根据投入数量的减少、与方法一致和输入范围一致的申报费用、以成本或不同问题为理由的替换以及计算答案的算法,对候选人不进行查询,对计划进行核查。 除了第3.1节中的属性外,执行法官报告规格中已有的计算。

blocks.en: G.3.1 Analysis
blocks.zh: G.3.1 分析

blocks.en: Test cases on small inputs admit false positives ( Li et al., 2022 ) , and the implementation judge rejects 717 of the 3,667 implementations (19.6%) that pass all test cases (Figure 18 ). • Fuel parameters (270). The implementation recurses on a fuel argument, which hides nontermination on inputs beyond the test cases. • Cost beyond the input bounds (234). The implementation is correct but exceeds the cost that the stated input bounds allow, known as a slow positive ( Li et al., 2022 ) . • Restated executable postconditions (198). The implementation repeats a computation of the executable postcondition that already runs within the stated input bounds. • Replayed test cases (15). The implementation returns stored outputs for the tested inputs. The implementation judge is waived after 2 retries, and 133 problems keep an implementation that the judge rejected. Of these, 89 are rejected for a fuel argument that may hide nontermination, 27 for cost beyond the input bounds, 12 for restating the executable postcondition and 5 for replaying test cases. 12 of the 133 are in AuXSpec -Test, and for the 9 among them rejected for fuel, the correctness proofs show that the fuel suffices on all valid inputs.
blocks.zh: 关于小投入的测试案例承认有假阳性(Li等,2022年),执行法官拒绝通过所有测试案例(图18)的3 667项实施中的717项(19.6%)。 • 燃料参数(270)。 实施工作在燃料论证上反复进行,这掩盖了对试验案例之外的投入的不终止。 二. 支助 超出输入范围的成本(234)。 执行是正确的,但超过了所声明的输入范围允许的成本,称为缓慢的正数(Li等,2022年). ^ 恢复可执行后条件(198年). 执行中重复了已运行在指定输入限内的可执行后条件的计算. • 重放测试病例(15起)。 执行结果返回储存的产出,供测试投入使用。 执行法官在两次复议后免于执行,133个问题保留了法官拒绝的执行. 其中89个因可能隐藏了不终止的燃料论证被否决,27个因超出输入界限的成本被否决,12个因重述可执行的后置条件被否决,5个因重放测试案例被否决. 133人中有12人在AuXSpec - Test中,其中9人因燃料被拒,正确性证明表明燃料足以满足所有有效投入。
