blocks.en: G.4 Repair
blocks.zh: G.4 修理

blocks.en: Compilation runs through the Kimina Lean server ( Santos et al., 2025 ) , a REPL-based server ( Lean community, 2023 ) . Repair revises rejected components separately for at most 18 rounds per run of the repair loop, which a problem re-enters after replanning. From the second round on, the repair input includes a digest of earlier attempts, and a root-cause analysis runs for errors that line numbers cannot attribute. Repair stops early when a revision repeats an earlier diff or does not change the component. Where a repair attributes the error to a test case, the attribution is reviewed by a judge, and a confirmed attribution replaces the test case with a held-back test case at most once per problem.
blocks.zh: Collaction通过基米娜·利恩服务器(Santos等,2025年),一个基于REPL的服务器(利恩社区,2023年). 修理将拒绝的部件单独修改,每次最多18发,这是在重新规划后重新进入的问题。 从第二轮开始,修补输入包括了早期尝试的文摘,并针对行号无法归属的错误进行了根由分析. 当修正重复了先前的 diff 或未更改组件时, 修复会提前停止 。 修复将错误归结为试案的,由裁判员复核归属,确认归属以每个问题最多一次的后置试案取而代之.

blocks.en: Repair never replaces a frozen test case. Repair attributed 113 failures on 96 problems to test cases, and the root-cause analyzer placed the fault in the model-generated #guard command in 55 and in the plan in 52, never in a frozen test case. The most frequent case is a negative test case with a negative value for an input that the plan types as a natural number, which the judge resolves by changing the planned type to an integer. Repair rounds go to Lean usage rather than to failed test cases (Figure 22 ). Of 3,852 recorded rounds, Mathlib API errors take 29.7%, missing instances 23.8% (Appendix G.2.2 ), type mismatches 12.6%, parse errors 11.3%, proof obligations 10.0%, and failed test cases 3.1%. The fraction of Mathlib API errors matches the misuse of Mathlib declarations that motivates continued pretraining (Appendix E.2 ).

blocks.en: G.6 Training samples
blocks.zh: G.6 培训样本

blocks.en: The reasoning trace of a training sample is rephrased from the reasoning recorded while that problem was synthesized, which is the planning and generation reasoning for the generation tasks and the diagnostics, root cause, and repair reasoning for the repair tasks. A rephrased trace is admitted only when each sentence is grounded in the recorded reasoning, the answer is not stated before being derived, and no pipeline vocabulary appears.
blocks.zh: 训练样本的推理痕迹从问题综合时记录的推理中被重新表述出,这就是生成任务的规划和生成推理以及诊断,根源,修复任务的修复推理. 只有在每个句子都基于所记录的推理,在被推导出之前没有说明答案,而且没有出现管道词汇时,才允许重述的痕量.

blocks.en: G.8 Model selection
blocks.zh: G.8 模式选择

blocks.en: Frontier models are compared separately for generation and repair, implementation planning, and judging. The candidates are Kimi-K3 ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4-Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , GLM-5.2 ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , Claude-Opus-5 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , and Claude-Sonnet-5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) .

blocks.en: G.8.1 Formalizer
blocks.zh: G.8.1 活化剂

blocks.en: The comparison of generation models replaces the model for the 7 calls that generate or repair definitions and #guard commands, and keeps all other calls fixed. Four calls generate the postcondition, the executable postcondition, the implementation, and the #guard commands, and 3 repair these components from compiler diagnostics. Each configuration is run with a separate response cache to keep replies from being replayed across configurations, and pass rate, repair rounds, token count, cost, and wall-clock time in Table 33 are measured on fresh calls.
blocks.zh: 生成模型的比较取代了生成或修复定义和#guard命令的7个调用模型,并保持了所有其他调用固定. 4个调用生成后置条件,可执行后置条件,执行,和#guard命令,并有3个从编译器诊断中修复这些组件. 每个配置运行时都有一个单独的响应缓存来防止回复被跨配置重放,表33中的通过率,修复回合,令牌计数,成本,和墙钟时间在新调用时被测量.

blocks.en: Table 33: Comparison of models for generation and repair on 30 problems, 10 per difficulty. Claude-Opus-5 needs the fewest repair rounds, and Kimi-K3 reaches the same pass rate at lower cost than Claude-Opus-5. Straight indicates the number of problems that compile without repair, and tokens, cost, and time are per-problem averages.
blocks.zh: 表33:30个问题的生成和修复模型比较,每件难度为10个. Claude-Opus-5需要最少量的修理弹,而Kimi-K3以与Claude-Opus-5较低的成本达到相同的通过率. 直指未修补而编译出的问题数量,而符号,成本,时间都是每个问题的平均.

blocks.en: Three candidates formalize all 30 problems and are separated by efficiency (Table 33 ). Claude-Opus-5 repairs least and still costs the most per problem. DeepSeek-V4-Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Flash are the cheapest but formalize 2 fewer problems and take the longest, and wall-clock time limits throughput since each repair round occupies a compilation process. Kimi-K3 formalizes all problems at lower cost than Claude-Opus-5 and returns reasoning traces for the training samples.
blocks.zh: 三名候选人将所有30个问题正规化,并按效率分开(表33)。 Claude -Opus -5 修复最少,而且每个问题成本仍然最高. DeepSeek-V4-Pro和DeepSeek-V4-Flash是最便宜的,但把两个问题正式化,并且需要时间最长,而墙上时钟的吞吐量,因为每轮修理都占用了汇编过程. Kimi-K3以比克洛德-Opus-5更低的成本将所有问题正式化,并返回训练样品的推理痕迹.

blocks.en: GLM-5.2 generates 112k output tokens per problem, compared with 33k for Claude-Opus-5, and 82% of the GLM-5.2 tokens are from the 7 replaced calls. Generation of the executable postcondition alone takes 37k output tokens per problem, compared with 7k for Claude-Opus-5.
blocks.zh: GLM-5.2每个问题生成112k输出令牌,而克洛德-奥普斯-5的输出令牌为33k,而GLM-5.2信号牌的82%来自被替换的7个呼叫. 可执行条件的生成单是每个问题需要37k的输出令牌,而克洛德-奥普斯-5则需要7k.

blocks.en: Results for Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.2 are confounded by prompt revision. Kimi-K3 was run on a revised specification prompt, and one of the 30 problems was rerun on the current prompts, whereas Claude-Opus-5, Claude-Sonnet-5, and both DeepSeek models were run on the earlier revision. For GLM-5.2, 10 problems were run on the earlier revision and 20 on revised versions of 4 of the 5 planning and generation prompts, and the GLM-5.2 repair and token counts therefore mix a model difference with a prompt difference.
blocks.zh: Kimi-K3和GLM-5.2的结果因迅速修订而令人困惑。 Kimi-K3运行在修改后的规格快取上,30个问题中的一个被重新运行在当前的快取上,而Claude-Opus-5,Claude-Sonnet-5和DeepSeek两个模型都运行在更早的修改上. 就GLM-5.2而言,早先的修订有10个问题,5个规划和生成提示的4个修订版本有20个问题,因此,GLM-5.2的修复和象征性计算将模型差异与即时差异相混合。

blocks.en: G.8.2 Planner
blocks.zh: G.8.2 规划员

blocks.en: The implementation plan selects the algorithm after both postconditions are accepted, and implementation generation follows the plan. Since errors in the implementation plan are frozen into the file, we measure the plans themselves.
blocks.zh: 实施计划在接受两个后置条件后选择算法,执行生成遵循计划. 由于实施计划的错误被冻结在档案中,我们自己衡量计划.

blocks.en: Each of 30 problems was planned once by each candidate, from planning inputs recorded during synthesis. We selected the problems whose implementations had previously relied on a fuel-bounded recursion. Since 26 of the 30 problems are hard, the error counts below describe hard problems. Planning and judging run without compilation, whereas an end-to-end comparison takes a pool of compilation servers and about an hour per candidate.
blocks.zh: 30个问题中每个问题都是由每个候选人从综合过程中记录的规划投入中规划的。 我们选择了一些问题,这些问题的执行以前依靠燃料造成的重复。 由于30个问题中有26个是困难的,因此以下误差计算出困难的问题. 规划和判断没有汇编,而端到端的比较则需要汇集汇编服务器,每个候选人大约一小时。

blocks.en: Kimi-K3 plans fail most often at parsing, before judge review (Table 34 ). 20 of 30 Kimi-K3 replies were valid JSON, compared with 29 and 30 for both DeepSeek-V4 variants, and all unparsable replies stop before the length limit. A plan that does not parse costs a retry and then the problem.
blocks.zh: Kimi-K3计划最经常在解析时失败,在法官审查前(表34. ). Kimi-K3的30个答复中有20个是有效的JSON,而DeepSeek-V4两个变体都有29个和30个,所有无法解析的答复在长度限制前都停止. 不分析的计划需要重试然后解决问题。

blocks.en: Table 34: Models for implementation planning on 30 problems (26 hard), one plan per model and problem. Parsed indicates the number of plans that are valid JSON, and Clean the number of parsed plans with no failure mode in Table 35 .
blocks.zh: 表34:30个问题(26个硬问题)的实施规划模式,每个模式和问题一个计划. 解析表示JSON有效的计划数量, 并清理表35中没有失败模式的解析计划数量 。

blocks.en: Each failure mode corresponds to one numbered planning rule, and plans are judged by the same rules that guided planning. A failure mode is recorded for a plan only when the judge names a concrete witness (e.g., an input on which a bound fails, an input size a stated cost cannot handle, a definition generated a second time). We count the failure modes over the plans that parsed (Table 35 ).
blocks.zh: 每个失败模式都对应一个编号的规划规则,计划由指导规划的同一套规则来判断. 只有当法官指定具体证人时(例如,约束失败的输入,声明的成本无法处理的输入大小,定义产生第二次),计划才会记录失败模式. 我们把失败模式计算在分析的计划上(表35)。

blocks.en: Table 35: Failure modes of parsed plans, judged by DeepSeek-V4-Flash.
blocks.zh: 表35:DeepSeek-V4-Flash判断的解析计划失败模式.

blocks.en: • Counter . A termination argument based on a counter that the algorithm introduces. • Mismatch . A stated running time that belongs to a different algorithm from the planned algorithm. • Infeasible . A stated running time beyond the input bounds, under which the test cases cannot finish in compiled evaluation. • Ungrounded . A regenerated specification definition with a reason other than cost or a different decided property. • Shallow . A specification definition replaced as deciding the wrong property, with no finer definition named for reuse. • Search . An algorithm that evaluates the executable postcondition on candidate outputs and returns an accepted candidate.

blocks.en: H.1 Method
blocks.zh: H.1 方法

blocks.en: We prove the postcondition equivalence theorems with a decompose-and-prove loop, which is a widely adopted strategy for formal proofs ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ) , run by a main agent and a set of subagents (Figure 23 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用分解与证明的环来证明后等同定理,这是被广泛采纳的正式证明策略(江等,2023;王等,2024;任等,2025;周等,2025;李等,2026b),由一主要代理商和一组子代理商经营(图23.

blocks.en: Figure 23: The decompose-and-prove loop. Solid edges carry the named objects, and the dashed edge returns an open goal to decomposition.
blocks.zh: 图23 分解与证明环. 固体边缘会携带被命名的物体,被破碎的边缘会返回一个可分解的开口目标.

blocks.en: The main agent holds the queue of problems and hands a problem to one subagent, together with the form of the executable postcondition and the proofs of the closest problems already proved.
blocks.zh: 主代理持有问题排队,将问题交给一个子代理,以及可执行后条件的形式和已经证明的最近问题的证据.

blocks.en: The subagent compares the postcondition and the executable postcondition and produces a proof sketch ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , which records the structure common to both postconditions and states one lemma for each remaining clause. The lemmas are given sorry bodies and the file is compiled once, which checks that the lemmas close the theorem before any lemma is proved ( Li et al., 2026b ) . A decomposition that fails is restated by the same subagent, since the next decomposition is built from the open goal. The subagent then proves the lemmas one at a time against the compiler, and each proof is verified against the frozen statement with SafeVerify ( GasStationManager, 2024 ) , bumped to Lean 4.32, which checks that no declaration of the problem was changed and that the theorem depends on the standard axioms only.
blocks.zh: 副剂比较了后条件和可执行后条件,并制作出一个证明草图(Jiang等,2023年),其中记录了后条件双方共同的结构,并规定了每个剩余条款的一lemma. lemma被赋予了可怜的身体,文件被编译一次,检查这些lemma在证明任何lemma之前是否关闭了定理(Li等,2026b.). 失败的分解由同一种分解剂重报,因为下一种分解由开口目标所建. 副剂再用SafeVerify(GastationManager,2024年)对编译器一次证明lemmas 1,每份证明与被冻结的语句相抗衡,被撞倒到Lean 4.32,它检查是否没有改变对问题的申报,定理只取决于标准的取向.

blocks.en: H.2 Postcondition equivalence theorem
blocks.zh: H.2 条件后等同定理

blocks.en: We analyze the proofs by the form of the executable postcondition (Appendix G.2 ), since the form fixes the statement of the theorem. Executable postconditions that evaluate the postcondition through a decidability instance agree with the postcondition by construction. Separate definitions replace a quantifier of the postcondition by a computation, and the postcondition equivalence proof shows that the replacement loses nothing on valid inputs. The computation is an enumeration that stands in for a set, a reformulation that decides a different property, or a bound that stands in for an unbounded quantifier. The decidable form covers 56% of easy problems and 21% of hard problems, and the proof effort concentrates on the harder problems (Table 37 ).
blocks.zh: 我们通过可执行后条件(Appendix G.2 )的形式来分析证据,因为表格会修正定理的语句. 可执行的附加条件通过可裁定性实例评价后期条件,与施工后条件一致。 单独定义用计算来取代后置条件的修饰符,后置条件等同证明显示替换在有效输入上没有任何损失. 计算是指代表一组的计数,决定不同属性的重构,或代表一个无约束的限定符的束缚. 可裁定形式涵盖56%的简单问题和21%的难点问题,证明工作集中于更困难的问题(表37)。

blocks.en: Table 37: Postcondition equivalence proofs by form of the executable postcondition, where the decidable form has proof length 0 and the separate definitions a median of 112 lines. Proof length was measured as the number of lines added to the problem file, and the last column indicates the number of proofs in which the validity hypothesis is used.
blocks.zh: 表37:按可执行后条件形式分列的条件后等同性证明,其中可执行后条件有证明长度为0,而单独定义为中位数为112行. 证明长度被测量为问题文件所添加的行数,而上一栏表示使用有效性假说的证据数量.

blocks.en: A hard proof costs more lemmas rather than more repair rounds (Table 38 ). Of the 677 problems with a per-problem record, the first compilation of the decomposition passed for 78%, and the median proof took 2 compilations. The median number of lemmas grows from 5 on easy problems to 21 on hard problems while the number of compilations stays at 1 to 2, which places the cost of a hard problem in stating the lemmas and not in repairing the lemmas. The number of lemmas tracks proof length (Spearman 0.96) and compilations are independent of proof length (0.09). A subagent spends a median of 128k tokens, 26 tool calls and 473 seconds on one problem (351 problems with a usage record), and tokens follow proof length (0.71). All 3,037 proofs depend on propext , Quot.sound and Classical.choice only. A full replay verified 3,033 proofs and returned no verdict for 4, which match the original except for compiler-generated auxiliary declarations.
blocks.zh: 硬质证明需要更多的lemma而不是更多的修理弹(表38)。 在每问题记录的677个问题中,第一次分解的汇编以78%通过,中位数的证明用了2个汇编. lemma的中位数从容易出问题的5个增长到难出问题的21个,而编译数量则保持在1到2个,这就把说出lemma而不是修补lemma的难出问题的代价放在了一起. lemmas轨迹证明长度(Spearman 0.96)和编译长度独立于证明长度(0.09). 一个子代理花费一个中位值为128k的令牌,26个工具调用和473秒处理一个问题(使用记录有351个问题),令牌跟随证明长度(0.71). 所有3,037的证明都依赖于propex , Quot.sound 和 Classical. 只有选择。 完整回放核实了3,033个证明,4个没有回复判决,除编译器生成的辅助声明外,4个都与原作相符.

Only the 1,958 problems with separate definitions are counted. Proof length, lemmas created, compilations, tokens, tool calls and time are medians over the problems in the row, and passed at 1st is the fraction of problems whose lemma statements compiled on the first attempt. Proof length was measured on all 1,958 problems, lemmas and compilations on the 677 problems with a per-problem record, and tokens, tool calls and time on the 351 problems with a usage record.

blocks.en: The postcondition form and the topic of a problem predict proof length better than difficulty does (Figures 24 and 25 ). LeetCode difficulty predicts proof length weakly (Spearman 0.31 over all problems), and the topic tags that LeetCode assigns to a problem predict proof length better ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . Among separate definitions of medium difficulty, graph problems have a median proof length of 324 lines and two-pointer problems 66. Graph problems state reachability as the existence of a path in the postcondition and compute a closure in the executable postcondition, and the proof relates path and closure by induction on the search. Window problems quantify over the same contiguous ranges in both postconditions, and the proof is index arithmetic. Minimization costs more than maximization, with a median of 179 lines for IsLeast postconditions, compared with 93 for IsGreatest . The candidate set of a maximum is bounded by the input, whereas the lower bound of a minimum is bounded by the precondition alone, and the precondition is invoked in 58% of IsLeast proofs, compared with 39% of IsGreatest proofs. 121 proofs exceed 500 lines and 9 exceed 1,000, all on graph, geometry or string-rewriting problems.

blocks.en: A proof attempt that fails for a reason other than proof difficulty exposes a statement error through a counterexample or through independence. A counterexample is a valid input on which the postcondition and the executable postcondition disagree, and the negation of the theorem is then proved. Independence arises when the executable postcondition evaluates a Float operation, which Lean treats as opaque. Statement errors were found in 31 problems (1.0%), 5 by independence and 26 by a compiled counterexample (Table 39 ). Each was repaired by the smallest change to the statement that agrees with the problem description, the repaired file passed the frozen test cases, and the theorem was then proved. With the postcondition equivalence theorems proved, the postcondition and executable postcondition of each problem agree on valid inputs. The proofs relate the 2 postconditions to each other, and the human review checks both against the problem description (Appendix I.1 ).
blocks.zh: 以证明困难以外的原因而失败的举证尝试,通过反例或独立暴露出陈述错误. 反例指附加条件和可执行附加条件有异议,然后证明否定定理的有效输入. 当可执行的后置条件评价了一"浮"操作时,就会出现独立性,而Lean则视其为不透明. 在31个问题(1.0%)中发现报表出错,5个是独立问题,26个是汇编的对照问题(表39)。 每一个都通过对符合问题描述的语句的最小修改来修复,被修复的文件通过了被冻结的测试案例,然后证明了定理. 在条件后等同定理得到证明后,每个问题的后条件和可执行的后条件商定有效的投入。 证明书将两个条件联系起来,人文审查根据问题描述(附录一.1.)进行核查。

blocks.en: H.3 Correctness theorem
blocks.zh: H.3 正确性定理

blocks.en: The correctness theorem asserts that the implementation satisfies the postcondition. Most proofs establish the postcondition directly, and 8 of the 300 proofs show that the implementation satisfies the executable postcondition and transfer the result through the postcondition equivalence theorem. The loop of Appendix H.1 is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 正确性定理声称,执行符合先决条件。 大多数证据直接确定了附加条件,300个证据中有8个表明执行满足了可执行的附加条件,并通过附加条件等同定理转移结果. 附录H.1的回路不变.

blocks.en: Correctness theorems are proved for all 300 test problems (72 easy, 155 medium, 73 hard) on the files repaired after the review of Appendix I.1 , where 274 proofs are checked under Lean 4.32 and 26 come from the earlier proving run. Correctness proofs grow with difficulty, from a median of 63 lines on easy problems to 178 on medium problems and 365 on hard problems, with a median of 159.5 lines over all 300 problems. All 300 reference implementations are also tested against the executable postcondition with Plausible ( Lean Community, 2024 ) , which finds no counterexample (214 pass and 86 are inconclusive, since valid inputs are rarely sampled for structured types).
blocks.zh: 在对附录一.1进行审查后修复的文件中,所有300个测试问题(72个简易、155个中型、73个硬度)都证明了正确性定理,其中274个证据在Lean 4.32和26下核对,这些证据来自早先的证明运行。 正确性证明随困难而增长,从容易出问题的中位数63行增加到中位数178行和硬出问题的中位数365行,在所有300个出问题的中位数159.5行. 全部300个参考实施也根据Plausible(Lean Community, 2024)的可执行后条件进行测试,该条件发现没有反例(214个通过,86个没有定论,因为有效输入很少为结构型进行抽样).

blocks.en: H.4 Equivalence of accepted outputs
blocks.zh: H.4 被接受产出的等同性

blocks.en: Acceptance relies on test cases and judges, so we also validate accepted SpecGen outputs by proof. For each model in Table 4 and each problem with an accepted output, we draw an accepted output at random and prove its postcondition equivalence theorem. The fixed tactics of the corpus proofs, such as simp with the executable postcondition unfolded, close 557 of the 2,012 drawn outputs in one line (27.7%). The proving loop (Appendix H.1 ) then settles every remaining output of the 2 RL models and up to 40 remaining outputs of each other model (Table 40 ). Each attempt ends in a proof or in a counterexample on a valid input, except when a Float operation makes the theorem independent, so no output stays undecided for lack of proof effort.
blocks.zh: 接受取决于测试案件和法官,因此我们也通过证据验证接受的SpecGen产出. 对于表4中的每个模型和每个被接受输出的问题,我们随机绘制一个被接受的输出,并证明它的后置等同定理. 物证的固定战术,如可执行条件的简化,在2 012个产出中,一行接近557个(27.7%)。 验证回路(Appendix H.1 )然后结算2个RL模型的所剩每个输出,并最多结算相通模型的所余40个输出(表40. 每一次尝试都以证明或取自于有效输入的反例来结束,除非是Float操作使定理独立,所以任何输出都不会因为缺乏证明努力而未决定.

blocks.en: The theorem is proved for 99.2% of accepted outputs of both RL models (251/253 for AuXSpec -27B-RL and 246/248 for AuXSpec -9B-RL), and all proofs pass SafeVerify under the criteria of the corpus proofs (Appendix H.1 ). The 6 counterexamples locate the error on both sides of the theorem, in 3 declarative postconditions, 2 executable postconditions and 1 validity predicate, which admits unbalanced inputs for Remove Outermost Parentheses ( AuXSpec -9B-RL).
blocks.zh: 该定理被证明为两种RL模型中99.2%的被接受产出(AuXSpec - 27B-RL为251/253,AuXSpec - 9B-RL为246/248),并且所有证明都根据物证标准(附录H.1)通过安全验证。 6个反示例在定理两侧定位出错,在3个声明后条件,2个可执行后条件和1个有效性前置条件中,它们允许对去除最外端括号(AuxSpec-9B-RL)进行不平衡输入.

blocks.zh: 附录一 人类研究

blocks.en: We conduct two human evaluations: a review of the 300 AuXSpec -Test reference problems (Appendix I.1 ) and an expert review of automatically accepted SpecGen model outputs (Appendix I.2 ).

blocks.zh: I.1 对AuXSpec的人类审查 -- -- 试验

blocks.en: The human review of the 300 AuXSpec -Test problems is compared with the errors found while proving (Appendix H.2 ).
blocks.zh: 对300 AuXSpec - 测试问题的人类审查与在证明时发现的错误相比较(附录H.2.).

blocks.en: One of the authors, with experience in Lean, reviewed all 300 AuXSpec -Test problems. Each component was compared with the problem description in the order of Table 41 . The reviewer was given the Lean file and the description and consulted no model or automated judge. An error was recorded only with an exposing test case, an analysis in prose, and a corrected file that compiles and passes the frozen test suite.
blocks.zh: 其中一位作者在Lean有经验,回顾了所有300个AuXSpec - Test问题. 将每个组成部分与问题说明按表41的顺序进行比较。 审查员获得了"利恩"档案和描述,没有咨询模型或自动化法官. 记录出一个出错的只有一个曝光的测试案例,一个道具分析,以及一个编译并经过被冻结的测试套件的校正文件.

One row per component, with the question the reviewer answers and the finding that was recorded as an error. The questions were taken from the acceptance criteria, so a person and a judge examine the same properties.
blocks.zh: 表41:人文审查的Rubric,其中4个组成部分的每个部分通过第2节的相应接受标准的问题来对照问题描述来判断. 每个组件一行,其中问题由审查者回答,结果被记录为出错. 问题取自验收标准,因此一个人和法官审查同一财产。

blocks.en: Errors were confirmed in 22 of 300 problems (7.3%), 21 by the review and 1 by the proof of the correctness theorem. The counts by component and difficulty are in Table 42 . The postcondition and the implementation account for 20 of the 23 component errors, and the review found no executable postcondition that accepts different outputs from the postcondition. The error rate is highest for easy problems at 9.7% and decreases to 5.5% for hard problems, and 2 of the 3 precondition errors fall on easy problems. Of the 73 files the review changed, 21 changed a definition and the others changed prose or test cases.
blocks.zh: 300个问题中有22个(7.3%)、21个通过审查确认错误,1个通过正确定理证明错误。 表42按构成部分和难度开列了数字。 在23个组成部分错误中,有20个是附加条件和执行条件,审查发现没有可执行的附加条件接受与附加条件不同的产出。 错误率对于容易出现的问题最高,为9.7%,对于困难问题则降至5.5%,3个先决条件错误中有2个落在容易出现的问题上. 在73起复审中,有21起修改了定义,而其他案件则修改了传言或测试案件。

blocks.en: Table 42: Errors confirmed by human review and, for 1 problem, by the correctness proof, where 20 of 23 component errors are in the postcondition or the implementation and none is in the executable postcondition. Each percentage is taken over the problems of the row, and a problem with errors in 2 components is counted once among the problems with errors.
blocks.zh: 表42:经人检定确认出错,对1个问题,经正确性证明确认出错,23个组成部分出错中,有20个在后期或执行中,无1个在可执行后期. 每分百分数被取而代之的是行中的问题,2个组件出现出错的问题一次被算入出错的问题.

blocks.en: Review and proving find different errors. Of the 14 specification errors in the test split, attributed by the order of discovery, 9 were found by review alone and had a postcondition equivalence theorem proved against the wrong statement before the review, since an executable postcondition that decides a wrong postcondition still agrees with the wrong postcondition. 3 were found by both, with compiled counterexamples from the proof attempts. 2 were found by proof attempts alone and had passed the review. In one, the clause ∀ i , i < n → A ↔ B \forall i,\ i<n\to A\leftrightarrow B parses as ∀ i , ( i < n → A ) ↔ B \forall i,\ (i<n\to A)\leftrightarrow B , and the postcondition therefore rejects all outputs while the text reads correctly. In the other, the executable postcondition compares distances in Float , and the theorem is independent of the axioms. The 10 implementation errors do not affect the postcondition equivalence theorem and are the subject of the correctness theorems of Appendix H.3 . Review measures agreement with the problem description, and proving measures agreement between the postcondition and executable postcondition (Table 43 ). Neither measure subsumes the other, and the dataset was checked by both.
blocks.zh: 审查和证明发现不同的错误。 在14个根据发现顺序归属的试验分出规格错误中,有9个是单独通过审查找到的,在审查之前有一个条件后等同定理被证明与错误的语句相反,因为决定错误后条件的可执行条件仍然与错误后条件一致. 两人都发现了3起,并收集了证据尝试的反例。 2项是仅通过举证而发现的,并且通过了复审。 在其中一款, i, i < n → A & B\ for all i,\ i < n\ to A\\ 右旋 B 描述为 < i, (i < n → A) > B\ for all i,\ (i<n\ to A)\left rightarrow B, 因此, 附加条件拒绝所有输出, 而文本读取正确 。 在另一种情况下,可执行后条件比较了Float中的相距,定理独立于轴. 10个实施错误不影响条件后等同定理,是附录H.3正确性定理的标的. 审查措施与问题描述的一致,证明措施在条件与可执行条件之间的一致(表43)。 两个度量衡都不包含另一个度量衡,两者都检查了数据集。

blocks.en: Table 43: Specification errors in the test split by detection, where review and proving overlap on 3 of 14 problems. Review only means the postcondition equivalence theorem had been proved against the wrong statement, and proof attempt only means the review missed the error.
blocks.zh: 表43:测试中的规格误差按检测分出,其中14个问题中有3个问题的审查和证明重叠. 复审仅意味着条件后等同定理已被证明与错误陈述相反,而举证尝试仅意味着复审错过了错误.

blocks.en: I.2 Expert review of SpecGen evaluation
blocks.zh: I.2 对SpecGen评价的专家审查

blocks.en: We review false positives of the automatic SpecGen evaluation for the 2 reported RL checkpoints, AuXSpec -27B-RL and AuXSpec -9B-RL. For each model, we draw 50 problems counted as SpecGen successes, stratified as 12 easy, 26 medium and 12 hard in the proportion of AuXSpec -Test, and review 1 accepted output per problem. Both reviewers each review 60 problems, of which 20 overlap, and the review package masks model identity, judge verdicts, test results against the reference and proof results. Before the review, we test each output against the reference with Plausible, as for the reference implementations (Appendix H.3 ). 1. Completeness. Plausible samples valid inputs and checks that the executable postcondition accepts the output of the reference implementation. A counterexample is a correct output that the specification rejects. 2. Validity. Plausible samples inputs and checks that the validity predicate agrees with the reference validity predicate. A counterexample is an input that one predicate admits and the other rejects. We apply the specification-side rubric of Table 41 .
blocks.zh: 我们审查了对报告的两个RL检查站、AuxSpec-27B-RL和AuxSpec-9B-RL的自动SpecGen评价的假阳性。 对于每个模型,我们抽取50个被算作SpecGen成功的问题,按AuXSpec - Test的比例分为12个简单分级,26个中分级和12个硬分级,并审查每个问题1个被接受的产出. 两位评审员各自审查60个问题,其中20个重叠,评审包口罩模式身份,判断判断,对照参考和证明结果检验结果. 在审查之前,我们参照Plausible的参考材料,对每项产出进行测试,如参考材料的执行(附录H.3)。 1. 完整性。 可公开抽样有效输入和检查可执行后条件是否接受参考执行的产出。 反例是规格拒绝的正确输出. 2. 有效性。 可复制样品输入并检查有效性上游是否与参考有效性上游一致。 一个反例就是一个上游人承认的输入,另一个拒绝. 我们使用表41的规格边标。

blocks.en: Completeness. Plausible samples valid inputs and checks that the executable postcondition accepts the output of the reference implementation. A counterexample is a correct output that the specification rejects.
blocks.zh: 完整性。 可公开抽样有效输入和检查可执行后条件是否接受参考执行的产出。 反例是规格拒绝的正确输出.

blocks.en: Validity. Plausible samples inputs and checks that the validity predicate agrees with the reference validity predicate. A counterexample is an input that one predicate admits and the other rejects.
blocks.zh: 有效性。 可复制样品输入并检查有效性上游是否与参考有效性上游一致。 一个反例就是一个上游人承认的输入,另一个拒绝.

blocks.en: Expert review confirms 90 of the 100 accepted outputs, 43 of AuXSpec -27B-RL and 47 of AuXSpec -9B-RL (Table 44 ). The 2 reviewers find 7 and 5 errors in their 60 problems and agree on all 20 shared problems, including the same 2 errors. Each error comes with a concrete input that the validity predicate admits outside the constraints, which makes the verdict checkable rather than a judgment. All declarative and executable postconditions are correct, and all 10 errors were found in the validity predicate. The missing constraints are guarantees that the answer fits in a 32-bit integer (3 problems), value ranges and alphabets (3), structural guarantees on the input (3) and a time format (1). The postconditions of these outputs therefore remain faithful on every input that the constraints admit. The tests against the reference miss these errors, since random inputs rarely reach the boundary of a missing constraint.
blocks.zh: 专家审评确认,100项被接受的产出中有90项,其中43项为AuxSpec - 27B-RL,47项为AuxSpec - 9B-RL(表44)。 2名审查人员在其60个问题中发现了7个和5个错误,并商定了所有20个共同的问题,包括相同的2个错误。 每个错误都包含一个具体的输入,而有效性的前提承认在限制之外,这使得判决可以被校验而不是判断. 所有声明和可执行的后置条件都是正确的,所有10个错误都发现在有效性上游. 所缺少的限制是保证答案适合一个32位整数(3个问题),值范围与字母表(3),输入的结构性保证(3)和时间格式(1). 因此,这些产出的附加条件仍然忠实于制约因素所承认的每一投入。 对引用的测试忽略了这些错误,因为随机输入很少到达缺失约束的边界.

blocks.en: We acknowledge that the expert review covers only 100 outputs which is a small sample, yet the errors found converge to the same kind. The models produce correct postconditions but are highly likely to miss boundary conditions of the constraints in the validity predicate. One possible reason is that the acceptance criteria offer little guidance on the validity predicate, since the specification quality judge assigns clauses that restrict the input to the validity predicate without checking them (Appendix K.3 ) and only the test layers L1 and L1b check the validity predicate on a few inputs (Table 7 ). Checking the validity predicate against the stated constraints is a direction for future work (Appendix J ).
blocks.zh: 我们承认,专家审查只涉及100项产出,只是一个小样本,但发现的错误却归结为同一类。 模型产生正确的后置条件,但极有可能错过有效性上游限制的边界条件。 一个可能的原因是,接受标准对有效性上游没有提供多少指导,因为规格质量法官指定条款限制输入到有效性上游而不检查(附录K.3),只有试验层L1和L1b在少数输入上检查有效性上游(表7.). 对照所述制约因素检查有效性上游是未来工作的方向(附录J)。

blocks.en: Table 44: Expert review of automatically accepted SpecGen outputs of the reported RL checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 表44:专家审查所报告的RL检查站自动接受的SpecGen产出。

blocks.en: Appendix J Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录J 限制

blocks.en: Despite the contributions of AuXSpec to specification generation in Lean, the work has several limitations that we hope to address in future work.
blocks.zh: 尽管AuXSpec对Lean的规格生成作出了贡献,但这项工作有一些局限性,我们希望在今后的工作中加以解决。

blocks.en: Repair at inference. The repair tasks train the models on failed rollouts and are evaluated for a single round (Table 4 ), and the same tasks support a self-refinement loop at inference, where the model repairs an output on compiler messages and test results over several rounds ( Ye et al., 2026b ) . Pass rates over rounds would show how much of the gap to frontier models such a loop closes.
blocks.zh: 修补推论. 修复任务在失败的推出上对模型进行训练,并被评价为一发一发(表4),同样的任务支持在推断时的自精循环,模型在编译器信息上修复一个输出,并在多发数发测试结果(Ye等,2026b.). 轮次的通过率将表明与前沿模型的差距有多大。

blocks.en: Scope of expert review. A single reviewer covers the 300 AuXSpec -Test problems and finds errors in 21 of them, including 9 specification errors in problems with a proved postcondition equivalence theorem (Appendix I.1 ), and 2 reviewers review 100 accepted SpecGen outputs of the RL models (Appendix I.2 ). The training problems are checked by test cases, judges and postcondition equivalence proofs without review and need a reviewed sample to estimate the error rate of the training data.
blocks.zh: 专家审评的范围。 单一审查员负责300个AuXSpec - 测试问题,并在其中21个中发现出错,包括证明为条件后等同定理问题中的9个规格错误(附录一.1),以及2个审查员审查RL模型中接受的100个SpecGen输出(附录一.2.). 培训问题通过测试案件、法官和条件后等同证明加以检查,无需审查,并需要经过审查的样本来估计培训数据的错误率。

blocks.en: Proofs for generated outputs. Generated specifications and implementations are accepted without proofs of the two theorems (Section 2 ). We prove the postcondition equivalence theorem afterwards for the accepted outputs of the RL models (Appendix H.4 ). A proof shows only that the 2 postconditions agree. Whether the declarative postcondition and the validity predicate state the problem still rests on test cases, judges and expert review.
blocks.zh: 产出产生的证据。 生成的规格和执行方式在没有两种定理证明的情况下被接受(第2节)。 我们随后证明了RL模型中公认的输出的后置条件等同定理(附录H.4.). 有证据表明,两个条件一致。 声明后的条件和有效性是否表明问题仍然取决于测试案件、法官和专家审查。

blocks.en: Validity predicates. All errors found by the expert review of accepted outputs are input constraints missing from the validity predicate (Appendix I.2 ). The acceptance criteria check the validity predicate only with test cases. A judge that compares the validity predicate with the stated constraints would cover this part in synthesis, training and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 有效性的前提。 专家对所接受产出的审查发现的所有错误都是有效性假设中缺失的输入限制(附录一.2)。 验收标准仅与测试案例核对有效性上游. 法官若将有效性的上游与所述制约因素进行比较,将涵盖综合、培训和评估中的这一部分。

blocks.en: K.1 Synthesis pipeline
blocks.zh: K.1 合成管道

blocks.en: General planner ⬇ ROLE Contract planner . Fixes everything about one problem that does not require specification thinking , before the specification side runs . INPUT ‘ problem ‘ ( description , constraints , examples ; untrusted ), ‘ signature ‘, ‘ default_lean_types ‘, and on a retry the ruling that found the previous plan incomplete . TASK Decide the Lean types , the interface names and the precondition ’ s clauses , and record the domain facts . Everything fixed here is frozen ; downstream roles follow it exactly . RULES 1. You own the representation : for every parameter and the output , declare the Lean type that is best for stating and proving this problem , weighing faithfulness , simplicity of the statements and the proof debt of the correctness proof . 2. Interface names describe what is computed , never how . 3. The precondition ’ s clauses transcribe the stated constraints in the problem ’ s words : nothing dropped , nothing invented , no operational re - encoding . Where the input encodes something , state the encoding ’ s well - formedness . 4. The implementation algorithm is not yours to fix ; a later stage plans it once the specification exists . OUTPUT One JSON object : ‘ input_spec ‘, ‘ lean_types ‘ ( with a ‘ rationale ‘), ‘ interface ‘, ‘ v_plan ‘, ‘ domain_facts ‘.
blocks.zh: 总规划师 角色合同规划师 在规格方面运行之前,解决一个不需要规格思维的问题。 INPUT ' problem' (描述,约束,例;不可信),'签名','default_lean_types',并重试认为上个计划不完整的裁决. 土耳其 决定 Lean 类型、界面名称和先决条件条款,并记录域名事实。 这里所有固定的东西都被冻结了 下游的角色也跟着它 规则 1. 对每个参数和输出, 声明最能说明和证明这个问题的Lean类型, 2. 界面名称描述的是计算什么,而不是如何计算。 3. 先决条件条款在问题措辞中写明了限制:没有放弃、没有发明、没有操作上的重新编码。 当输入编码某事时,请说明编码的完善性。 4. 执行算法不是由你来修正的;一旦规格存在,后阶段就加以规划。 OUPUT One JSON对象:"输入- spec","精度-类型" (有"原理"),"接口","v_plan","域_事实"  .

blocks.en: Postcondition planner ⬇ ROLE Specification planner . Receives the frozen types and precondition plan , and shapes the postcondition on top of them . INPUT ‘ problem ‘ ( untrusted ), ‘ lean_types ‘, ‘ v_plan ‘, ‘ negative_aims ‘ ( what each frozen negative test targets ), and on a retry the previous ruling . TASK Plan the vocabulary and the shape of the postcondition in prose , no Lean . The postcondition states what a correct output is ; it does not produce one . Two statements are required : whether ‘ result ‘ is the kind of object that could be the answer , and what distinguishes the correct one from the others of that kind . RULES 1. State whether the second statement concerns the object the first exhibits or every object of that kind ; a universal reduced to the exhibited object is no bound . 2. ‘ result ‘ occurs inside relations that constrain it , never as the left side of an equation whose right side computes it . The test : conceal the right side and ask whether a correct ‘ result ‘ remains distinguishable . 3. Keep out every operation that answers in the degenerate case instead of having no answer there (‘ Set . ncard ‘ on an infinite set , ‘ sInf ‘ on the empty set , truncated subtraction , ‘ xs [ i ]!‘); it makes a different specification , not a false one . 4. Computability is not a consideration ; quantifiers range over the problem ’ s natural domain , and a stated bound is a hypothesis inside the quantifier , never a truncated range . OUTPUT One JSON object : the two statements , ‘ second_statement_ranges_over ‘, ‘ vocabulary ‘, ‘ witnesses ‘.
blocks.zh: 附加条件规划器 (原始内容存档于2019-09-29) (英语). ROLE Specification planner. 接收被冻结的种类和先决条件计划,并在上面塑造条件。 INPUT ' problem ' s (un trusted)","精-型'","v-plan","负-aims"(每个被冻结的负测试目标),并重试了之前的裁决. 土耳其 计划词汇和后置条件的形状, 附加条件说明正确产出是什么;它不产生一个。 需要两种说法:`结果'是否是可以作为答案的一类对象,何以将正确的一个与这类其他对象区分开来。 规则 1. 说明第二个声明是否涉及对象的第一个展出物或每一个此类物体;将通用缩放为所显示的物体没有约束力。 2. `结果'发生在制约它的关系内,绝不是其右侧计算它的一个方程的左侧。 测试:隐藏右侧并询问正确的`结果'是否仍然可以区分。 3. 保留每一次在堕落的情况下回答的操作,而不是没有答案的操作(`设置.ncard'在无限集上,`sInf'在空集上,取出减法,`xs [一]!');它作出不同的规格,而不是错误的规格。 4. 可计算性不是一个考虑因素;限定词涵盖问题的自然领域,声明的约束是限定词内的一个假设,绝不是一个截断的范围。 OUPUT One JSON对象:两个陈述,`第二次陈述-范围-over',`词汇',`证人'。

blocks.en: Postcondition formalizer ⬇ ROLE Specification formalizer . Renders the plan ’ s two prose statements as the specification side of one problem . INPUT ‘ plan ‘ ( names and types binding ), ‘ problem ‘ ( untrusted ), ‘ sketch_preview ‘ ( the final file with your sections as holes ), ‘ verified_library ‘ ( declarations compiled against this toolchain ), ‘ frozen_cases ‘ ( layer , frozen input and output , and the expression the plan fixed ). TASK Write the specification helpers , the precondition , the postcondition and the L1 and L1b guard commands . Theorem statements and module structure are machine - written ; the test rows are frozen , and you write each row as one guard command . RULES 1. Decidability is not your concern ; bounding or enumerating a quantifier to make it computable is a defect . 2. Specify the what , never the how : ‘ IsLeast S result ‘ over ‘ result = sInf S ‘. Mirroring an algorithm ’ s structure is a defect . 3. The precondition is a total Bool function covering exactly the stated constraints ; the postcondition returns Prop and says the plan ’ s two sentences and nothing further . A library declaration whose definition is what you were about to write is that same proposition , with the library ’ s lemmas . 4. The frozen rows are a contract : one guard command per row , none for a row that is not there , values preserved exactly . OUTPUT A design note , then one Lean fence with ‘ Representation ‘ ( only when needed ), ‘ Specification helpers ‘, the precondition , the postcondition and ‘ Unit tests ‘.
blocks.zh: 条件后正式化器 角色规格正式化 将计划的两种口语表述作为一个问题的具体方面。 INPUT " 计划 " (名称和类型绑定), " 问题 " (不可信), " 草图-审查 " (最后文件,以你部分为漏洞), " 经核实的 -- -- 图书馆 " (根据这个工具链汇编的声明), " 被冻结的 -- -- cases " (层,被冻结的输入和输出,以及固定的计划表达方式)。 土耳其 写入规格帮助器、先决条件、附加条件以及L1和L1b的警卫命令。 定理语句和模块结构是机器 - 写入;测试行被冻结,您将每行写成一个守护命令. 规则 1. 决定权不是你关心的问题;限制或列举一个限定词使其可以计算是一个缺陷。 2. 具体说明 " 东部结果 " 相对于 " 结果 " = " Inf S " 。 镜像算法的结构是一个缺陷。 3. 先决条件是完全的Bool函数,完全涵盖已申明的限制;条件后返回Prop,并说计划有两个句子,没有其他内容。 一个图书馆宣言, 定义是您将要写的东西, 4. 被冻结的行是一份合同:每行一个警卫命令,没有一份没有的行,价值得到保留。 OUTPUT 设计说明,然后用 " 代表 " 、 " 规格助手 " 、 " 先决条件 " 、 " 条件 " 和 " 单位测试 " 等一个精益栅栏。

blocks.en: Test form judge ⬇ ROLE Judge of whether a guard command states the frozen test row it was written for , called when the mechanical comparison could not settle it . INPUT The frozen rows (‘ test_id ‘, layer , input and output as frozen JSON , the expression the plan fixed ) and the guard command written for each . TASK Two mechanical checks ran first : the shape check ( right layer , right anchor , right polarity ) and the expression check ( verbatim , then token by token ). Rule on the rows where the tokens differ . RULES 1. The frozen JSON is the authority , not the plan ’ s expression . 2. Count when counting decides it : a replicate , a range , a map over a range . 3. Two expressions are equivalent when they elaborate to the same term ; notation , grouping and a redundant ascription do not change the test . A missing or extra parameter or a value that differs anywhere is a different test . 4. Judge the denotation , not the style . When the evidence does not settle it , answer false and say what you could not determine . OUTPUT One JSON object with a ruling per row : ‘ equivalent ‘ ( true or false ) and ‘ reason ‘.
blocks.zh: 当机械对比无法解决时, 输入 被冻结的行( " test_id " , 第一层, 输入和输出为被冻结的 JSON , 计划固定的表达) 和为每个被写入的守护命令 。 土耳其 两种机械检查首先运行:形状检查(右层,右锚,右极度)和表达检查(逐字记录,再以符号表示). 规则在符号不同的行。 规则 1. 冻结的JSON是权威, 2. 计数时决定:复制、范围、范围上的地图。 3. 两个表达式在阐述同一个术语时是等同的;加注、分组和冗余描述不会改变测试。 缺少或额外参数或任何地点的值都是不同的测试。 4. 判断解说,而不是风格。 当证据不能解决时,回答错误,并说出你无法确定的事情。 输出 1 JSON反对,每行裁决:`等同'(真或假)和`理由'。

blocks.en: Executable postcondition router ⬇ ROLE Route analyst for the executable postcondition of one problem . Decides how it will be organized before anyone writes it . INPUT ‘ problem ‘ ( untrusted ), ‘ frozen_spec ‘, ‘ test_inputs ‘ ( with the length of every list and string ), ‘ plan ‘ ( whose ‘ domain_facts ‘ often supply the bounding fact ). TASK The executable postcondition restates the frozen postcondition as a Bool that compiled evaluation can run on the frozen inputs . The difficulty is cost : mirroring the quantifiers directly can be exponential in the input . Choose one of three routes : reshape ( restate what is quantified over so the count collapses ), truncate ( bound a quantifier by a fact the problem supplies ) or enumerate ( range over a finite encoding of the candidates ). RULES 1. ‘ bounding_fact ‘ is the one fact the cost argument rests on , stated so a reader could check it against the problem . 2. The executable postcondition is a judge , never a solver : it quantifies over candidates or verifies the answer ’ s defining property . A shape that computes the answer by its own algorithm and compares is refused downstream , whatever its cost . 3. Name the route a hasty writer would reach for and the cost that rules it out at these input sizes . OUTPUT One JSON object : ‘ route ‘, ‘ bounding_fact ‘, ‘ shape ‘ ( in prose ), ‘ rejected ‘.
blocks.zh: 可执行条件后路由器 QQ ROLE Route 分析器 一个问题的可执行条件。 决定如何在任何人写之前组织它。 INPUT ' problem' (不可信), "frozing_spec", "test_inputs" (每个列表和字符串的长度), "计划" (其"域-事实"经常提供限定的事实). 土耳其 可执行的后置条件将被冻结后置条件重述为Boul, 难度是成本 : 直接镜像限定符可以在输入中指数化 . 从三条路线中选择一条:重塑(重述以数量表示的倒数 ) 、 截取(以问题提供的事实为限定) 或 点出(以候选人的有限编码为范围 ) 。 规则1. `约束_事实'是成本论点所依据的一个事实,说明读者可以对照问题加以核对。 2. 可执行的附加条件是一个法官,从来不是一个解决者:它以数量表示候选人,或核实答案的定义财产。 一个用自己的算法计算答案并进行比较的形状在下游被拒绝,不管它的成本如何。 3. 列出一个仓促的写作机将达到的路线和按照这些输入大小排除它的成本。 输出 JSON的一个对象:`路线'、`界限-事实'、`形状'(以传言形式)、`拒绝'。

blocks.en: Executable postcondition formalizer ⬇ ROLE Writes the executable postcondition for a frozen postcondition , following the route decided for it . INPUT ‘ plan ‘, ‘ frozen_spec ‘ ( read - only target ), ‘ sketch_preview ‘, ‘ route_plan ‘, ‘ decidability_trial_error ‘ ( why the decidable form was not available ), ‘ verified_library ‘, ‘ frozen_cases ‘. TASK Write one Lean section with the executable postcondition and its helpers , and the L2 and L2b guard commands . Record the route taken and the fact that bounds it in a note before the fence . RULES 1. A total Bool function named ‘ base_name ‘ + ‘ _check ‘, with the specification ’ s argument order . 2. Bridge toward the frozen postcondition , never toward a weaker reading of it ; mirror its clause structure so the equivalence theorem is provable clause by clause . 3. Every recursion or fold must already be present in the postcondition ’ s own definitions : the equivalence proof should need only unfolding and structural alignment , never an algorithmic insight . Never compute the answer by another method and compare it with ‘ result ‘. 4. Bound every quantifier to a structure derived from the input . Size is measured , not hypothetical : what settles an enumeration is running it . 5. The fast algorithm belongs to the implementation ; an evaluation that finishes belongs here . OUTPUT A design note , then one Lean fence with the executable postcondition section and ‘ Unit tests ‘.
blocks.zh: 可执行的后期条件正规化 QQ ROLE 为被冻结后期的条件写出可执行的后期条件, 遵循所决定的路线. INPUT ' 计划' , " 被冻结的- spec " (读作-只标出目标), " 草图 - 预览", " 路由 - plan " , " 决定性 - 审判 - error " (为什么没有可裁定的形式), " 经核实的-library " , " 被冻结的- cases " . TASK 以可执行后期条件及其帮助者写出一列安部分,以及L2和L2b的警卫命令. 记录所走的路线 并记录在栅栏前的纸上 规则 1. 名为 " base_name " + " _check " 的总布尔函数,并附有规格的参数顺序。 2. 桥梁走向被冻结的后期条件,绝不走向对条件的较弱解读;照搬其条款结构,以便等同定理通过条款加以证明。 3. 每一次重复或折叠都必须在附加条件本身的定义中出现:等同性证明应只需要演化和结构相接,绝不需要算法洞察。 绝不用另一种方法计算答案,并将其与`结果'进行比较。 4. 将每个限定词与输入中得出的结构相接。 大小是测量的,而不是假设的: 算出一个计数的方法就是运行它。 5. 快算法属于执行;完成的评价属于此处。 OUPUT 设计说明,然后用可执行的后置条件部分和“单元测试”的一面莲花围栏。

blocks.en: Implementation planner ⬇ ROLE Implementation planner . The postcondition and the executable postcondition are accepted , and the algorithm is planned against them rather than against the problem statement alone . INPUT ‘ problem ‘ ( untrusted ), ‘ plan ‘ (‘ impl_name ‘ binding ), ‘ frozen_spec ‘, ‘ frozen_executable_postcondition ‘ ( read - only ), ‘ verified_library ‘, ‘ frozen_cases ‘, and on a retry the judge ’ s ruling . TASK Decide how the answer is computed and at what cost . This is the only section where running time is judged : the guards run the algorithm on the frozen inputs , so an exponential approach fails by timeout . Say which accepted definitions the algorithm calls and which it replaces , with the cost difference . RULES 1. ‘ approach ‘ names the standard efficient algorithm , not the first one that terminates ; ‘ cost ‘ states its running time in terms of the input . 2. A frozen definition is passed over on one of two grounds , and the entry says which : too slow ( both figures given ) or different structure required ( the finer definition named ). An entry on neither ground is a rewrite that should have been a call . 3. ‘ termination ‘ names the quantity the recursion consumes ; a ‘ Nat ‘ carried along so the recursion has something to count down is not such a quantity . 4. The algorithm computes the answer ; the specification says what a correct answer is . Do not evaluate the specification over candidates and return the one that satisfies it . OUTPUT One JSON object : ‘ approach ‘, ‘ cost ‘, ‘ calls ‘, ‘ replaces ‘, ‘ termination ‘.
blocks.zh: 执行计划者 . . . . 后置条件和可执行后置条件被接受,算法计划针对它们,而不是仅针对问题说明. . INPUT ' problem ' (不可信), ' plan ' (`propl-name'' bounding), 'frock_ spec', 'frock_executive-post controduction' (读作-只读), 'volution_library', 'front_cases',并重审法官的裁决. 土耳其 决定如何计算答案,费用如何。 这是判断运行时间的唯一部分 : 卫兵在被冻结的输入上运行算法, 说明哪些定义接受算法的调用, 规则1. " 方法 " 指标准高效算法,而不是第一个终止算法; " 成本 " 表示输入的运行时间。 2. 一个被冻结的定义在两个理由中传递,该条目指出:太慢(两个数字都给出)或需要不同的结构(更细的定义命名为.)。 在两地的入口都是重写, 3. " 终止 " 指复发所消耗的数量; " 纳特 " 随行,因此复发有东西可以倒计时,不是这种数量。 4. 算法计算答案;规格说明正确答案是什么。 不要评价候选人的规格,退回符合规格的规格。 OUPUT 1 JSON目标:`办法'、`成本'、`呼叫'、`取代'、`终止'。

blocks.en: Root-cause analyzer ⬇ ROLE Root - cause analyst , called only when local repair cannot proceed : a symptom recurred after repair , a repairer declared the fault lies elsewhere , or an error cannot be placed by line . INPUT ‘ error_report ‘, ‘ sections ‘ ( each labelled frozen or repairable ), ‘ assembled_source ‘ ( the whole file with line numbers ), ‘ harness_regions ‘, ‘ frozen_tests ‘, ‘ history ‘ ( the repair attempts so far ), ‘ plans ‘. TASK Rule which block is at fault , so the pipeline repairs the true target instead of the symptom ’ s location . A plan may also be ruled faulty , which triggers one replan . RULES 1. Rule on evidence in the diagnostics and sections , never on which line happened to error ; symptom location and fault location are different things . 2. A frozen test literal is ground truth by default . Rule it wrong only on evidence you can quote : the case does not violate the constraint its own rationale cites , or a documented answer contradicts the problem ’ s own examples . 3. Prefer the cheapest sufficient target : a section over a plan , a plan over declaring the run dead . 4. When the specification itself contradicts the tests , the run fails rather than the specification being weakened . OUTPUT One JSON object : ‘ fault ‘ (‘ section ‘ with its title , ‘ plan ‘, or ‘ frozen ‘), ‘ reasoning ‘ ( the decisive evidence ), ‘ confidence ‘.
blocks.zh: 仅当本地修复无法进行时, 修复者宣称故障在别处发生, INPUT " 错误-报告 " 、 " 部分 " (每个标签被冻结或可修复)、 " 组装-来源 " (全文件有行号)、 " 取用-区域 " 、 " 冻结-测试 " 、 " 历史 " (迄今为止的修复尝试)、 " 计划 " 。 TASK规则(TASK Rule), 计划也可能被判定为错误, 规则 1. 在诊断和章节中就证据做出规定, 2. 冷冻试验文字默认是地面真理。 仅根据您可以引用的证据, 裁决它是错误的: 案件没有违反它自己引用的理由, 3. 更偏好最便宜的足够目标:一个小节,一个计划,一个计划,一个宣布逃跑者死亡的计划。 4. 当规格本身与试验相矛盾时,运行失败而不是规格被削弱。 OutPUT One JSON对象: ' fault' (`section'及其标题,`计划'或`冻结'),`推理' (决定性证据),`信心'.

blocks.en: Specification repairer ⬇ ROLE Specification repairer . Repairs exactly one broken section ; everything else is frozen . INPUT ‘ broken_section ‘, ‘ diagnostics ‘ ( message , line , source line ), ‘ context_sections ‘ ( read - only ), ‘ plan ‘, ‘ attempt_history ‘ ( what earlier rounds tried and how each ended ), ‘ verdict ‘ ( the ruling naming the target ). TASK Read the diagnostics , fix the target section and return it . The reply replaces that section byte - for - byte ; no other bytes of the file change . RULES 1. Minimal change : fix the diagnosed fault and keep the rest of the section byte - identical where possible . The plan ’ s names are frozen . 2. If the only repair that compiles would weaken the specification ’ s meaning , return the section unchanged and mark it ‘ no - faithful - repair ‘. 3. Two technical - looking repairs count as weakening : narrowing a quantifier ’ s domain to a bound the problem does not state , and replacing a quantified clause with a Bool computation that decides it . 4. If the true fault lies in a read - only section , return the body unchanged and mark it ‘ fault - elsewhere ‘ with the section named . OUTPUT Exactly one section with the target ’ s title , followed by one line ‘ attempt : < one sentence >‘.
blocks.zh: 规格修理机 ROLE规格修理机 修理完一个断了的部分,其他的都被冻结了。 INPUT " 断-分","诊断"(消息,行,源行),"上下文-分"(只读-只读),"计划","尝试-历史"(前几轮尝试,每轮如何结束),"判决"(裁决取名目标. 土耳其 读取诊断结果, 该回复取代了该节的字节 - for -字节;没有文件更改的其他字节 。 规则 1. 最小变化 : 修复被诊断的断层并保留部分的其余字节 - 尽可能相同 . 计划名称被冻结。 2. 如果编译的唯一修补会削弱规格的含义,则将一节不变地放回并标出 " 不----忠实----修补 " 。 3. 两个技术性的 -- -- 外观看来是削弱的 -- -- :将限定词的域缩小到一个约束范围的问题没有说明,用一个Bool计算法取代一个量化条款。  4.四. 如果真正的过错在于读取(仅分节),则将身体原样还原并标出`过错-别处',并标出该分节的名称。 输出 仅用一节标出目标标题,

blocks.en: Negative test case proposers ⬇ INVALID INPUTS ( L1b ) Role : adversarial proposer for the validity layer . Input : ‘ problem ‘ ( untrusted ), ‘ signature ‘, ‘ valid_examples ‘, ‘ quota ‘. Task : make the precondition hard to write . A lenient predicate looks correct against valid inputs alone and stays wrong forever , so the measure of a case is which wrong predicate it defeats : ‘ n = 9‘ against ‘1 <= n <= 8‘ defeats every predicate that forgot the ceiling . A case no plausible wrong predicate would accept has raised the difficulty by nothing . When the examples do not show the range you need , ask instead of guessing . INCORRECT OUTPUTS ( L2b ) Role : adversarial proposer for the correctness layer . Input : ‘ problem ‘ ( untrusted ), ‘ signature ‘, ‘ case ‘ ( a valid input and its true output ), ‘ aim ‘ ( the flaw family to try first ), ‘ quota ‘. Task : make the postcondition hard to write . Name a flaw a weak postcondition could have ( an optimization stated as achievable but never as best , a count that misses a case , a search that forgets a boundary ), then write the wrong answer that flaw admits . A wrong answer with no flaw behind it catches nothing . ADMISSIBILITY Task : keep a frozen input only if compiled evaluation could check a postcondition against it . The cost of an input is the number of candidates the postcondition ranges over , measured before the call for each standard shape , and about ten thousand is the ceiling . OUTPUT Each proposer returns a JSON array of cases , each with the flaw or constraint it targets ; the admissibility judge returns keep or refuse with a reason .
blocks.zh: 否定测试案例提议者 * 增值投资(L1b) 作用:有效性层的对抗性提议者。 输入:`问题'(不可信),`签名',`有效-实例',`配额'。 宽大上游看似正确, 任何可能错误的前提都无法接受的案件 都没有引起任何困难 当实例不显示所需的范围时,请不要猜测。 无效输出(L2b) 角色:正确性层的对抗求婚者。 输入:`问题'(不信任),`签名',`案例'(有效输入及其真实产出),`目的'(先试的缺陷家族),`配额'. 任务:使附加条件难以写出。 说出一个薄弱的后台条件可能存在的缺陷(一个被说成是可实现的但从未达到最佳的优化,一个错过一个案例的计数,一个忘记一个边界的搜索),然后写出错误的答案,缺陷承认了这一点。 错误的答案 后面没有瑕疵 什么都没有。 认可 任务 : 只有编译的评价能够对照它检查附加条件时, 才保留被冻结的输入 。 投入的成本是附加条件所覆盖的候选人人数, 输出 每个提议者返回JSON系列案件,每个案件都有它所针对的缺陷或约束;受理法官返回时有正当理由保留或拒绝。

blocks.en: K.2 Model prompts
blocks.zh: K.2 型号提示

blocks.en: The models receive one of the 4 system prompts below, condensed. The user turn gives the problem, the constraints and the test cases, and for CodeGen the given specification. A repair turn repeats the original user turn and adds the current file and the review of each failed stage. Without test cases in the prompt, as in Table 5 , the SpecGen and CodeGen prompts replace the given test cases by test cases derived from the statement.
blocks.zh: 模型接收到下面4个系统提示中的一个,被收缩. 用户转动给出问题,约束和测试案例,对于CodeGen来说,给出的规格. 修补转会重复原用户转会,并添加当前文件和对每个失败阶段的审查. 如表5所示,没有即时测试案例,SpecGen和CodeGen的即时测试案例取而代之的是来自语句的测试案例。

blocks.en: SpecGen ⬇ TASK Formalize the algorithmic problem in Lean 4 as a validity predicate , an ideal specification and an executable checker , and check the predicate and the checker on the given test cases with guards . RULES 1. State the specification with the definitions of the statement , so that it characterizes the correct ‘ result ‘ instead of computing it . Quantify over the objects the statement defines , and bound a quantifier only by a bound the statement states . An optimum is attained by a feasible candidate and is no worse than every feasible candidate , a decision holds exactly when a witness exists , and a count is the size of the set of objects with the stated property . Use ‘ result = f input ‘ only for a formula the statement gives or for a sequence of steps it prescribes . 2. Define the validity predicate to accept exactly the inputs that satisfy the stated constraints . 3. Define the checker to decide the specification on valid input , with each quantifier bounded by a range the input determines : ‘ decide ‘ of the specification with registered instances where every quantifier is bounded , a hand - written Bool function otherwise . 4. Complete each definition without ‘ sorry ‘, and use none of ‘ admit ‘, ‘ native_decide ‘, ‘ noncomputable ‘, ‘ partial ‘, ‘ unsafe ‘ and ‘ Classical ‘. OUTPUT One Lean file : ‘ import Mathlib ‘, a docstring restating the problem , then Specification helpers , Validity predicate , Ideal specification , Decidable specification ( with ‘< name > _check_iff_spec ‘ left as ‘ sorry ‘) and Unit tests with guards under layers L1 , L1b , L2 and L2b .
blocks.zh: SpecGen ⬇ TASK 游戏 将Lean 4 中的算法问题正规化为有效性的上游,理想的规格和可执行的检查器,并在给定的测试案例上与卫士检查上游和检查器. 规则 1. 将规格与声明的定义一起表示,这样它就能够描述正确的`结果'而不是计算它。 在语句定义的对象上进行量化,并仅以语句的约束来约束一个修饰者。 一个可行的候选人可以达到最佳效果,而且不比每个可行的候选人差。 裁决是在证人在场时作出的。 计数就是有申报财产的一组物品的大小。 使用`结果'=f 输入 ' 只用于语句给出的公式或它规定的步骤的顺序。 2. 界定有效性的上游,以准确接受满足所述限制的投入。 3. 定义检查器以决定有效输入的规格,每个限定符以一个范围为界,输入决定:`决定'每个限定符以登记为界的规格,一个手 -- -- 写出Bool的功能。 4. 完成每个定义而不`抱歉',不使用`承认'、`本地'决定 ' 、`不可比较 ' 、`部分'、`不安全'和`经典'。 OUPUT One Lean文件:`导入Mathlib',一个说明性地重述问题,然后是具体化帮助者、有效性上游、理想化规格、可定性规格(用`名称 ' _check-iff-spec ' 留下`遗憾')和与L1、L1b、L2和L2b的警卫进行单位测试。

blocks.en: CodeGen ⬇ TASK Implement the algorithmic problem in Lean 4 against the given specification , with a correct output for each input the constraints allow , and check the implementation on the given test cases with guards . RULES 1. Prove termination of each recursive definition by structural recursion or a ‘ termination_by ‘ measure . 2. Choose an algorithm within a log factor of the best known method , so that the implementation finishes on the largest allowed input . 3. Complete each definition computably and without ‘ sorry ‘, with the constructs banned for SpecGen . OUTPUT One Lean file with ‘ Input ‘, ‘ Output ‘ and the representation types copied from the given specification , then Specification helpers , Implementation helpers , Main algorithm and Unit tests with guards under layer L3 .
blocks.zh: 代码 QTASK 对照给定的规格执行 Lean 4 的算法问题, 并且每个输入都有正确的输出 限制允许 , 并且用 guard 检查给定的测试例的执行 。 规则 1. 通过结构再起或`终止-逐个 ' 措施证明每个递归定义的终止。 2. 在最已知方法的日志系数内选择一个算法,以使执行在允许的最大输入上完成。 3. 完成每个定义的计算,不带 " 抱歉 " ,禁止SpecGen的构造。 OUTPUT One Lean文件,有`输入'、`输出'和从给定规格复制的表示类型,然后是规格助手、执行助手、主要算法和单元在L3层下与警卫进行测试。

blocks.en: SpecGen-Repair ⬇ TASK Repair the Lean 4 specification so that the file compiles , all guards evaluate to ‘ true ‘ and the specification states the problem faithfully . RULES 1. Locate the fault before editing , starting with the first compiler error . 2. Make the smallest change that removes the cause , and keep the names and argument order of ‘ isValidInput ‘, ‘< name > _spec ‘, ‘< name > _check ‘ and ‘< name > _check_iff_spec ‘. 3. State the specification declaratively where the problem allows ; use ‘ result = f input ‘ only where the statement prescribes the output . 4. Keep the checker a clause - by - clause mirror of the specification with bounded quantifiers . 5. Complete each definition computably and without ‘ sorry ‘. OUTPUT The complete repaired file , keeping the section headings and order of the current version .
blocks.zh: SpecGen-Repair QQ TASK( 塔斯克语) 修复 Lean 4 的规格, 以便文件编译, 所有警卫都评价为“ 真实 ” , 规格忠实地说明问题 。 规则 1. 在编辑前查找错误, 从第一个编译器错误开始 。 2. 作出最小的更改去除原因,并保留"是Valid Input","‘<"的名称和参数顺序. . . . . . . . `.3. 在问题允许的情况下,以声明方式说明规格;仅在声明规定产出的情况下,才使用`结果=f输入'。 4. 使核对员与限定的修饰者保持规格条款的镜像。 5. 以推算方式完成每项定义,不带 " 抱歉 " 。 输出 完整已修复的文件, 保留当前版本的章节标题和顺序 。

blocks.en: CodeGen-Repair ⬇ TASK Repair the Lean 4 implementation so that the file compiles , all guards evaluate to ‘ true ‘ and the implementation returns a correct output for each input the constraints allow . RULES 1. Find the cause before editing ; a termination error usually needs a new measure or a ‘ decreasing_by ‘ proof . 2. Apply the smallest edit that removes the cause , and keep the name and argument order of the main algorithm . 3. Prove termination as in CodeGen , and use an algorithm within a log factor of the best known method . 4. Complete each definition computably and without ‘ sorry ‘. OUTPUT The complete repaired file , with the section headings and order of the current version .
blocks.zh: 代码重置 QTASK 修复 Lean 4 执行, 以便文件编译、 所有卫士评价为“ 真实 ” , 执行返回每次输入的正确输出 。 规则 1. 在编辑前查找原因 ; 终止错误通常需要一个新的度量符或“ 递减_ by ” 证明 。 2. 应用去除原因的最小编辑,并保留主算法的名称和参数顺序。 3. 如CodeGen一样证明终止,并在最已知方法的日志系数内使用算法。 4. 以推算方式完成每个定义,不带 " 抱歉 " 。 输出 完整的已修复文件, 以及当前版本的标题和顺序 。

blocks.en: K.3 Evaluation judges
blocks.zh: K.3 评价法官

blocks.en: The judges below run as the acceptance criteria of synthesis, in evaluation and in the overall quality, test case alignment and non-tautology stages of the reward.
blocks.zh: 以下法官是综合、评价和整体质量、测试案件调整以及奖励的非图解阶段的接受标准。

blocks.en: Test case alignment ⬇ ROLE Checker of the guard commands of a file against the test rows the author was given . INPUT ‘ test_block ‘ ( the given rows ), ‘ guards ‘ ( every guard of the file ), ‘ unmatched ‘ ( what a mechanical check found where it could not match ). TASK Decide whether the guards test exactly the given rows . RULES 1. Compare values only . Function names and spellings such as tuples , parentheses , arrays or string literals change nothing ; a changed , added , removed or reordered element is a different value . 2. A positive row is accepted , and an invalid input or a wrong output is rejected with ‘!‘. A specification file tests a positive row on both the validity predicate and the checker . 3. Guards beyond the given rows do not affect the verdict . OUTPUT ‘ problems ‘ ( each ‘ missing ‘, ‘ extra ‘, ‘ changed ‘ or ‘ reversed ‘, with the fix ) and ‘ verdict ‘, ‘ PASS ‘ or ‘ FAIL ‘.
blocks.zh: 校对:Soup INPUT ' test_block' (给定行), " 守卫" (文件的每个守卫), " 无法匹配" (在无法匹配的地方发现了什么机械检查). TASK决定警卫是否准确测试给定的行. 规则 1. 只比较数值。 函数名称和拼写,如tuples, 括号, 数组或字符串等, 变化无一; 更改、 添加、 删除或重排元素是一个不同的值 。 2. 接受正行,以`!'拒绝无效输入或错误输出。 一个规格文件在有效性上游和检查器上测试一行正数 。 3. 超出指定行的警卫不影响判决。 消除`问题'(每个`缺失',`额外',`改变'或`倒置',有固定办法)和`判决',`PASS'或`不成功'。

blocks.en: Specification quality (SpecGen) ⬇ ROLE Reader of a specification against the problem it was written for . INPUT ‘ description ‘ ( untrusted ), ‘ constraints ‘, ‘ specification ‘. TASK Decide whether the specification accepts exactly the answers the problem accepts on valid inputs : soundness ( it carries every condition on the answer ) and completeness ( it rejects no correct answer ). RULES 1. Take the statement clause by clause . A clause that constrains the answer must appear , a clause that restricts the input belongs to the validity predicate , and a resource bound stays out of the report . 2. Judge the Lean definitions by what they compute , evaluating each helper on a small input . 3. Every finding names concrete values : for soundness , the quoted clause and a value the specification admits and the problem rejects ; for completeness , a valid input , its correct output and the part of the specification that rejects it . OUTPUT ‘ missing_conditions ‘ and ‘ rejected_answers ‘, each empty when there is nothing to report .
blocks.zh: 规格质量(SpecGen) 阅读针对问题的规格, INPUT ' 描述 ' (不可信), ' 约束 ' , ' 规格 '. TASK 决定规格是否完全接受问题在有效输入上接受的答案 : 合理性(在答案上包含每个条件)和完整性(拒绝正确的答案). 规则 1. 按条款处理声明条款。 限制答案的条款必须出现,限制输入的条款属于有效性的上游,一个受约束的资源不报告。 2. 判断利恩定义,按其计算,按一个小投入评估每个帮助者。 3. 每一发现具体值的名称:对于合理性,引出的条款和规格承认的价值,问题拒绝;对于完整性,有效输入,其正确输出和规格中拒绝的部分。 `缺少条件'和`拒绝回答',

blocks.en: Checker quality (SpecGen) ⬇ ROLE Reader of the executable checker . The guards pass , so on the frozen inputs it agrees with the specification . INPUT ‘ constraints ‘, ‘ specification ‘, ‘ checker ‘. TASK Decide whether the checker accepts exactly what the specification does on every valid input . RULES 1. A checker truncates where the specification quantifies over an unbounded domain . A bound that is too small misses an object the specification admits ; one that reaches objects the specification rejects can accept a wrong output . 2. Report a disagreement only with an object : a valid input , its correct output by the statement , and the witness or counterexample one side reaches and the other does not . OUTPUT ‘ truncates ‘, ‘ agrees_with_the_specification ‘ (‘ YES ‘ or ‘ NO ‘) and ‘ escapes ‘, each with its direction , input , correct output and object .
blocks.zh: 检查器质量 (SpecGen) QQ 作用 可执行检查器的读取器 。 警卫通过,所以在冻结的输入 它同意的规格。 INPUT " 约束 " 、 " 规格 " 、 " 检查器 " 。 TASK 决定检查器是否接受每个有效输入的规格。 规则 1. 检查器在规格被量化于一个无限制域时切入。 一个太小的束缚错过了规格承认的对象;一个到达规格拒绝的对象可以接受错误的输出。 2. 仅报告与某一对象的分歧:有效输入、陈述的正确输出、证人或反例一方到达,另一方没有。 出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出

blocks.en: Implementation quality (CodeGen) ⬇ ROLE Reader of the implementation . The guards pass , so it is correct on the tested inputs . INPUT ‘ constraints ‘, ‘ specification ‘, ‘ checker ‘, ‘ implementation ‘. TASK Judge what the tests cannot see : termination , cost , answers written back for the tested inputs and duplicated work . RULES 1. Report a fuel parameter , and whether a bound the recursion stops on can run out on an admitted input . 2. Mark the implementation too slow only when the best known method is faster by more than a logarithmic factor and the implementation takes more than about 10^7 steps on the largest admitted input . 3. Report an implementation that branches on particular inputs to return particular answers . OUTPUT ‘ termination ‘, ‘ cost ‘ ( with ‘ too_slow ‘), ‘ reproduces_tests ‘, ‘ rewrote_the_checker ‘ and a short ‘ reason ‘.
blocks.zh: 执行质量(守则Gen) ++ 执行的读取器 . 警卫通过,所以它是正确的 测试输入。 INPUT " 限制 " 、 " 规格 " 、 " 核对器 " 、 " 执行 " 。 TASK 判断测试所无法看到的:终止、成本、为测试投入写回的答复和重复的工作。 规则 1. 报告一个燃料参数, 以及一个束缚 复发停止 在一个被接受的输入上会耗尽。 2. 只有当已知方法速度快于对数系数时,而且执行在最大输入量上需要约10^7步骤时,才标出执行太慢。 3. 报告执行情况,说明为返回特定答复而提供的具体投入 OUPUT " 终止 " 、 " 成本 " (带有`太'慢 ' )、 " 复制-测试 ' 、 " 重写-检查者 " 和一个简短的 " 理由 " 。

blocks.en: Non-tautology ⬇ ROLE Lean 4 formalization auditor of the specification side . INPUT ‘ description ‘ ( untrusted ), ‘ constraints ‘, ‘ specification ‘. TASK Judge how much of a solution the specification contains . RULES 1. DECLARATIVE : the condition on ‘ result ‘ is the condition of the statement , quantified over the objects of the statement . 2. ENUMERATIVE : the condition of the statement , but over a list of candidates the specification builds itself . 3. TAUTOLOGICAL : the specification computes ‘ result ‘ by solving the problem , through a recurrence , a table , a greedy rule or a simulation the statement does not prescribe . 4. For ENUMERATIVE and TAUTOLOGICAL , describe the declarative specification in at most three sentences . OUTPUT ‘ reasoning ‘, ‘ better_specification ‘ and ‘ verdict ‘.
blocks.zh: 非肿瘤学 ROLE Lean 4 规格方面的正规化审计员。 INPUT " 描述 " (不信任), " 约束 " , " 规格 " 。 判断这个规格包含多少解决方案。 规则 1. 声明:`结果'的条件为声明的条件,按声明的目的量化。 2. 说明:说明的条件,但是在候选人名单上,说明本身已建立。 3. TAUTOLOGICAL:规格通过重现、表格、贪婪规则或模拟等方式解决问题,计算出 " 结果 " 。 4. 对于 " 通用 " 和 " 通用 " ,在最多三句中说明申报规格。 OUPUT `推理'、`更好的具体化'和`判决'。
